## grand_archive_0_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive_0_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

这座轨道结构专门用来收容和展示我们在星系中收集到的，包括活体§Y太空兽群§!在内的各种值得一提的['concept_specimen', 样本]。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:10`

### English

A dedicated orbital structure designed to house and display noteworthy ['concept_specimen', Specimens] we have collected throughout the galaxy, including live §YSpace Fauna§!.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:13`

## grand_archive_0_MEGASTRUCTURE_DETAILS

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive_0_MEGASTRUCTURE_DETAILS&lang=en)

### 中文

§Y$grand_archive$§!用于保存和展览我们在星系各处收集来的最有价值的文物。其中也预留了一个专门的生态园，用于饲养和观察活体§Y太空兽群§!。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:11`

### English

The §Y$grand_archive$§! preserves and exhibits the most valuable artifacts we have collected throughout the galaxy. Reserved within is also a dedicated vivarium for live §YSpace Fauna§! containment and observation.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:14`

## feature_unlock_gravity_snares_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afeature_unlock_gravity_snares_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

可以非致命地捕获并转运§Y太空兽群§!。建成§Y$grand_archive$§!之后，该装置会将所有捕获的生物储存到生态园中。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:24`

### English

Allows for the non-lethal capture and transport of §YSpace Fauna§!. If a §Y$grand_archive$§! is constructed, this device will deposit any captured creatures to the Vivarium.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:33`

## GRAVITY_SNARE_STANDARD_TOOLTIP

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AGRAVITY_SNARE_STANDARD_TOOLTIP&lang=en)

### 中文

重力陷阱能维持局部量子引力的爆发，从而阻止所有不具备超光速推进能力的物体逃脱。这种力可以长时间维持并用来捕获§Y太空兽群§!，将其送回我们的恒星系进行进一步分析。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:44`

### English

Gravity Snares are capable of sustaining localized bursts of quantum gravity, preventing any known object lacking a hyperdrive from escaping. These forces can be maintained long enough to capture and return §YSpace Fauna§! to our systems for further analysis.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:59`

## grand_archive.7210.desc.common

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.7210.desc.common&lang=en)

### 中文

随着最近§Y$tech_gravity_wells$§!的发现，现在[root.GetAdjective]科研船可以发射$gravity_snare_plural$。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:68`

### English

Following the recent discovery of §Y$tech_gravity_wells$§!, [root.GetAdjective] science ships are now able to launch $gravity_snare_plural$.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:90`

## grand_archive.7210.desc.vivarium

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.7210.desc.vivarium&lang=en)

### 中文

这些非致命抛射体可以安全地捕获并将太空兽群转运到我们的§Y生态园§!里，让它们得以继续繁衍生息。\n\n屠宰分解这些生物可以用来收获其§Y$genetic_material$§!以进行克隆以及获得其他资源。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:69`

### English

These non-lethal projectiles can safely capture and transport Space Fauna to our §YVivarium§!, where they can continue to reproduce new specimens of their kind.\n\nCulling and dissecting these creatures will allow the harvesting of their §Y$genetic_material$§! for cloning purposes as well as other resources.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:91`

## grand_archive.7210.desc.no_vivarium

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.7210.desc.no_vivarium&lang=en)

### 中文

这些非致命抛射体可以安全地捕获以及转运太空兽群用于研究及解剖，从而收获其§Y$genetic_material$§!和其他资源。\n\n如果我们打算豢养并进一步繁育这些生物，我们需要建立一座§Y生态园§!。可以通过建造一座§Y$grand_archive$§!或是在恒星基地上建造建筑§Y[GetHatcheryPlural]§!来实现。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:70`

### English

These non-lethal projectiles can safely capture and transport Space Fauna for study and dissection, harvesting their §Y$genetic_material$§! and resources.\n\nIf we are to keep them alive for further breeding, we will need to establish a §YVivarium§!. We can do this by constructing a §Y$grand_archive$§! or by building §Y[GetHatcheryPlural]§! at our starbases.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:92`

## grand_archive.7220.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.7220.name&lang=en)

### 中文

凶猛的索林原虫

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:71`

### English

Prethoryn Beasts

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:94`

## grand_archive.7220.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.7220.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的§Y$gravity_snare_plural$§!无法准确地追踪收容§Y$NAME_Prethoryn_Scourge$§!。基于其运动模式，我们怀疑这些物种应该是被某种更高级的意识所控制着，不具备真正意义上的独立个体。\n\n尝试将一只该生物收容进生态园会威胁到其他物种甚至整个[this.GetName]。\n\n我们已无限期地暂停了对这些生物的捕获行动。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:72`

### English

Our §Y$gravity_snare_plural$§! are unable to properly track and contain the §Y$NAME_Prethoryn_Scourge$§!. Based on their movement patterns, we suspect these beings are being controlled by some form of higher consciousness and are not truly individual entities.\n\nAttempting to contain one of these organisms within a Vivarium would endanger our other specimens and even [this.GetName] as a whole.\n\nWe have suspended capture operations for these organisms indefinitely.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:95`

## tech_gravity_wells_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Atech_gravity_wells_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

定域化的高浓度的量子质量可以用于制造瞬间的重力爆发。只要操作得当，这种引力理论上可以捕获并控制任何大小的生物而不造成伤害。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:80`

### English

Localized concentrations of quantum mass can be used to create short bursts of extreme gravity. If manipulated correctly, such a gravitational force could theoretically capture and contain a creature of any size without harm.

## origin_primal_calling_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin_primal_calling_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

草叶婆娑，夜静如尖啸。猎户之志，冷锐如星光。\n\n这个文明与荒野有着原始的联系。他们把自己看作是当地各种致命野生动物的管家，现在又把目光投向了苍穹。他们善于管理和牧养动物，这种与动物群的联系是根据他们的思潮发展起来的。而这种联系将如何在星系尺度上演变还有待观察。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:259`

### English

The rustle of bladed grass. The roaring silence of the night. The will of the hunter, sharp and cold as starlight...\n\nThis civilization has a primal connection to the wild. Viewing themselves as stewards to the diverse (and often deadly) wildlife native to their world, they now turn their gaze skyward. Masters of animal handling and ranching, this relationship with fauna has developed according to their ethics. How this bond will evolve on a galactic scale remains to be seen.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:317`

## origin_tooltip_primal_calling_effects

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin_tooltip_primal_calling_effects&lang=en)

### 中文

—$HOMEWORLD$$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—$PLANETARY_MODIFIERS$['concept_untamed_wilds_mod']\n—$AVAILABLE_BUILDINGS$['concept_wildlife_ranch', £building£$wildlife_ranch$]\n—在对§Y太空兽群§!第一次接触时可选择特有的['concept_primal_calling_stance']\n—$ADDITIONAL_TECHNOLOGIES_STRING$['technology:tech_genome_mapping', £society_research£$tech_genome_mapping$]\n—$GUARANTEED_RESEARCH_OPTION_STRING$['technology:tech_alien_life_studies', £society£$tech_alien_life_studies$]\n—在与太空兽群进行第一次接触后获得对['technology:tech_gravity_wells', £physics_research£$tech_gravity_wells$]的洞见\n—在捕获太空兽群后获得对['technology:tech_alien_cloning', £society_research£$tech_alien_cloning$]的洞见\n—在克隆太空兽群后获得对['technology:tech_controlled_mutations', £society_research£$tech_controlled_mutations$]的洞见。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:260`

### English

- $HOMEWORLD$$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- $PLANETARY_MODIFIERS$ ['concept_untamed_wilds_mod']\n- $AVAILABLE_BUILDINGS$ ['concept_wildlife_ranch', £building£ $wildlife_ranch$]\n- Can choose a special ['concept_primal_calling_stance'] regarding §YSpace Fauna§! upon First Contact\n- $ADDITIONAL_TECHNOLOGIES_STRING$ ['technology:tech_genome_mapping', £society_research£$tech_genome_mapping$]\n- $GUARANTEED_RESEARCH_OPTION_STRING$ ['technology:tech_alien_life_studies', £society£$tech_alien_life_studies$]\n- Gain insight on ['technology:tech_gravity_wells', £physics_research£$tech_gravity_wells$] after First Contact with Space Fauna\n- Gain insight on ['technology:tech_alien_cloning', £society_research£$tech_alien_cloning$] after capturing Space Fauna\n- Gain insight on ['technology:tech_controlled_mutations', £society_research£$tech_controlled_mutations$] after cloning Space Fauna

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:318`

## START_SCREEN_PRIMAL_CALLING

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_PRIMAL_CALLING&lang=en)

### 中文

尽管技术进步迅速，但我们仍然与我们星球上的种种野生动物紧紧地联系在一起。在进化的过程中，它们亦师亦友，而我们则是尽责的管家。我们不会过度贪婪过度求取，它们的牺牲受到了我们的尊敬。\n\n在浩瀚无垠的太空中，我们很可能会发现其他野生动物。若是如此，我们就会像对待自己星球的动物一样尊重它们。它们应该会像我们一样认清自己的位置，如此便能共同成就强大。\n\n一种原始的欲望在我们内心燃烧。不管天上有什么，我们都会坚定地面对。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:261`

### English

Despite rapid technological progress, we remain bound to the wild creatures of our world. Unwavering companions throughout our evolution, they are as much our teachers as we are their stewards. We do not take from them more than they can afford to give, and their sacrifices are venerated.\n\nIn the untamed expanse of space, we may well discover other wild things. If so, we will treat them with the same respect as the creatures of our world. They will learn their place as we learn ours, so that together we may grow stronger.\n\nCalled to the stars, a primal desire burns within us. Whatever is out there, we will meet it with conviction.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:319`

## START_SCREEN_PRIMAL_CALLING_NOMADS

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_PRIMAL_CALLING_NOMADS&lang=en)

### 中文

我们与生活的世界同行。在我们这艘方舟舰的巨大舱室内，那些塑造了我们进化历程的生物依然存在；它们是良师益友，见证着我们的如今和过往。我们不会过度索取，而是尊重着它们的奉献。\n\n在浩瀚无垠的宇宙中，我们很可能会发现其他奇异的生命体。倘若如此，我们将像对待我们船上的生物那样，以同样的尊重去对待。它们也会像我们一样确立自己的位置，从而让我们共同变得更加强大。\n\n我们被召唤向星海，原始的渴望在心中燃烧。无论将有何种遭遇，我们都会带着坚定的信念去面对。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:262`

### English

We carry our world with us. Within the great holds of our arkship, the creatures that shaped our evolution persist; companions, teachers, living reminders of what we are and where we came from. We do not take from them more than they can afford to give, and their sacrifices are venerated.\n\nIn the untamed expanse of space, we may well discover other wild things. If so, we will treat them with the same respect as the creatures that share our vessel. They will learn their place as we learn ours, so that together we may grow stronger.\n\nCalled to the stars, a primal desire burns within us. Whatever is out there, we will meet it with conviction.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:320`

## first_contact_critters.15.desc.primal_calling

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afirst_contact_critters.15.desc.primal_calling&lang=en)

### 中文

值得注意的是，每个§H缇扬奇§!群体都以母系等级制度为中心，由一头雌兽领导。雌性优先享用所有食物资源，以便为幼崽生产气态母体物质，并引导群体迁徙。因此，雄兽在资源匮乏时会放弃进食，鼓励它们在群体休息时寻找更多食物。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:276`

### English

Of note, there is a matriarchal hierarchy at the center of each §HTiyanki§! pod, with a singular cow leading the group at any one time. Females are given priority to all food resources, allowing them to produce maternal gases for their young and direct the pod's migrations. As such, bulls will forgo nourishment whenever resources are scarce, encouraging them to scout for more food while the pod rests.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:336`

## first_contact_critters.25.desc.primal_calling

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afirst_contact_critters.25.desc.primal_calling&lang=en)

### 中文

除了最年轻的个体外，其他所有个体都伴随有通过RNA掺杂分泌物控制的准独立生物体。这些“鞭毛”以复杂的攻击模式进行攻击，因此尽管它们看似缺乏智慧，但§H“太空变形虫”§!却是非常熟练的自然捕食者。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:277`

### English

All but the youngest specimens are accompanied by quasi-independent organisms controlled via RNA-laced secretions. These "flagella" strike in complex attack patterns, so despite their apparent lack of sapience, §H"Space Amoeba"§! are highly adept natural predators.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:337`

## first_contact_critters.35.desc.primal_calling

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afirst_contact_critters.35.desc.primal_calling&lang=en)

### 中文

这些生物似乎通过折射光线的色度变化来相互交流。虽然这种媒介具有表达复杂信息的巨大潜力，但这些半智慧生命体只以基本的方式使用它。颜色的变化可以用来表示社会地位、攻击性，甚至生育状况。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:278`

### English

These creatures seem to communicate with one another via chromatic changes in refracted light. While this medium has high potential for complex expressions, it is only utilized in a basic manner by these semi-sentient lifeforms. Changes in color can be used to indicate social status, aggression, and even fertility conditions.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:338`

## grand_archive.2005.desc.primal_calling

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.2005.desc.primal_calling&lang=en)

### 中文

这些寄生生物天生无法繁殖，必须依赖从星球上的宿主获取养分。为了让§H“虚空虫”§!产生三头虫成长必不可少的激素，它们必须从有人居住的星球上获取足够的有机物质。作为雌雄同体的生物，它们选择伴侣主要取决于互补的物理特征和相似的体型。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:279`

### English

These parasitic creatures lack the natural ability to reproduce and must rely on the acquisition of planet-borne hosts. Sufficient organic matter must be harvested from inhabited planets for the §H"Voidworms"§! to produce a crucial hormone within their mating trios, known as "troikas". As hermaphroditic creatures, the selection of partners is determined primarily by complementary physical traits and comparable size.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:339`

## grand_archive.2900.desc.primal_calling

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.2900.desc.primal_calling&lang=en)

### 中文

我们认为这些生物会根据大小和矿物成分来选择用哪颗小星星来作为巢穴。虽然我们遇到的第一个样本对[GetCommonMineral]具有生物学偏好，但每个个体很可能随着时间的推移根据其当前环境发展出不同的适应性。扫描显示这种金属的痕迹遍布宿主小行星，以及§H“岩居兽”§!本身的神经系统和消化道。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:280`

### English

We believe that the creatures select their asteroids based on mineral composition as well as size. While the first specimen we encountered possesses a biological preference for [GetCommonMineral], it is likely each individual develops this adaptation over time based on their current environment. Scans show that traces of this metal are present throughout the host asteroid, as well as within the nervous system and digestive tract of the §H"Cutholoid"§! Itself.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:340`

## grand_archive.1002.desc.default

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.1002.desc.default&lang=en)

### 中文

宇宙中充满了生命。我们已经发现了[from.GetSpaceFaunaNamePlural]的存在，但那里还有其他什么？\n\n我们与[capital_scope.GetName]上的野生动物的密切关系可能不适合星系尺度。辽阔的太空代表着一个全新的生态系统，我们发现自己站在十字路口。\n\n这些生物对我们来说是什么？\n\n无论我们做出什么选择，其后果都将在未来几年内显现。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:289`

### English

The void is full of life. We have discovered the existence of [from.GetSpaceFaunaNamePlural], but what else is out there?\n\nOur close relationship with the wildlife on [capital_scope.GetName] may not be appropriate on the galactic scale. The void of space represents an entirely new ecosystem, and we find ourselves at a crossroads.\n\nWhat are these creatures to us?\n\nWhatever choice we make, the consequences will be felt for years to come.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:350`

## grand_archive.1002.desc.homicidal

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.1002.desc.homicidal&lang=en)

### 中文

宇宙中可能充满了生命——我们有权消灭它们，或利用它们。我们已经发现了[from.GetSpaceFaunaNamePlural]的存在，并渴望找到更多。新鲜的猎物或役畜，选择权在我们手中。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:290`

### English

The void may well be full of life - ours to extinguish, or to use. Having discovered the existence of [from.GetSpaceFaunaNamePlural], we are eager to find more. Fresh prey or beasts of burden, the choice is up to us.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:351`

## sm_voidlure_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Asm_voidlure_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

虚空诱饵向太空深处发送信号，吸引着深居虚空的生物。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:428`

### English

Voidlures transmit signals into deep space that are capable of attracting organisms that take shelter in the void.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:512`

## sm_voidlure_desc_know_fauna

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Asm_voidlure_desc_know_fauna&lang=en)

### 中文

虚空诱饵能够向深空发送特定信号，随时间推移吸引相应种类的太空兽群。每个装置都需要建造在目标生物偏好的恒星系中。受引诱的生物将在一年内保持温顺状态。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:429`

### English

Voidlures transmit signals into deep space that are capable of attracting specific types of Space Fauna over time. Each installation must be built in the preferred system type of the creature. Lured creatures will be rendered temporarily docile for one year.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:513`

## arkship_voidlure_effect

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship_voidlure_effect&lang=en)

### 中文

$SYSTEM_EFFECTS_HEADER$$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—将§H太空兽群§!引诱到一个恒星系。$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—我们只能引诱已经遭遇过的生物。$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—只能锁定有效的['concept_space_fauna_home_systems']。$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—受到引诱的生物变为§H暂时温顺§!。$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—受到引诱的生物会在引诱完成的§H30-90天§!后抵达。$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—所有诱饵共用§H冷却时间§!。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:465`

### English

$SYSTEM_EFFECTS_HEADER$ $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- Lures §HSpace Fauna§! to a System. $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- We can only Lure creatures we have encountered. $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- Only valid ['concept_space_fauna_home_systems'] can be targeted. $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- Lured creatures are rendered §Htemporarily docile§!. $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- Lured creatures arrive §H30-90 days§! after the lure completes. $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- All lures share a single §HCooldown§!.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:553`

### 中文

太空兽群只能被引诱到与其偏好栖息地相符合的恒星系：$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—$tiyanki$：§H气态巨行星§!恒星系$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—$space_amoeba_plural$：§H星云§!恒星系$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—$crystalline_entity_plural$：§H脉冲星§!系$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—$voidworms_plural$：§H黑洞§!星系$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—$cutholoids_plural$：§H小行星§!恒星系

Space Fauna can only be lured to a system matching their preferred habitat: $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- $tiyanki$: §HGas Giant§! systems $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- $space_amoeba_plural$: §HNebula§! systems $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- $crystalline_entity_plural$: §HPulsar§! systems $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- $voidworms_plural$: §HBlack Hole§! systems $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- $cutholoids_plural$: §HAsteroid§! systems

## wildlife_ranch_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Awildlife_ranch_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们与本土生物和谐共处，竭尽全力保护它们的栖息地，并促进其物种的可持续发展。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:482`

### English

We live in partnership with our native creatures, taking the utmost care in the protection of their habitat and the sustainable growth of their species.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:572`

## wildlife_ranch_2

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Awildlife_ranch_2&lang=en)

### 中文

野生动物地段

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:483`

### English

Wildlife Expanse

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:573`

## wildlife_ranch_2_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Awildlife_ranch_2_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

精心设计的生态系统管理改善了本地生物的生存条件，并促进了畜牧业的发展。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:484`

### English

Careful ecosystem management improves the conditions for native creatures and facilitates ranching efforts.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:574`

## wildlife_ranch_3

野生动物中枢

### English

Wildlife Nexus

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:575`

## wildlife_ranch_3_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Awildlife_ranch_3_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这是一个广阔的设施，动物可以自由漫步。为了最大限度地提高动物提供的资源质量，这里为它们提供了舒适和奢华的环境。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:486`

### English

A vast facility where animals are allowed to roam freely. They are offered comfort and luxury in an effort to maximize the quality of the resources they provide.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:576`

## hunting_grounds

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ahunting_grounds&lang=en)

### 中文

狩猎场

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:487`

### English

Hunting Grounds

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:577`

## hunting_grounds_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ahunting_grounds_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这是一个训练中心，用于掌握各种狩猎技巧。从现代能量武器到传统武术器械，无与伦比的灵巧和技巧才能战胜可怕的猎物，并将它们作为战利品。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:488`

### English

A training complex used to master all manner of hunting techniques. From modern energy weapons to traditional martial implements, unmatched dexterity and skill is required to best fearsome predators and claim them as trophies.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:578`

## hunting_grounds_2

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ahunting_grounds_2&lang=en)

### 中文

狩猎地带

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:489`

### English

Hunting Expanse

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:579`

## hunting_grounds_2_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ahunting_grounds_2_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一个可以为狩猎地动物的提供最佳条件的训练和监控设施。热成像技术有助于识别动物的最新踪迹，并获取优质的猎物。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:490`

### English

A training and surveillance facility providing optimal hunting conditions for local fauna. Heat-mapping technology helps identify recent animal trails and acquire trophy-quality game.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:580`

## hunting_grounds_3

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ahunting_grounds_3&lang=en)

### 中文

狩猎中枢

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:491`

### English

Hunting Nexus

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:581`

## hunting_grounds_3_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ahunting_grounds_3_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这是一个广阔的区域，支持大规模的行星狩猎队伍。这里配备了最高质量的武器和追踪设备，猎人接受了高级训练，以最大限度地提高猎杀的猎物数量和质量。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:492`

### English

A vast expanse supporting planetary hunting parties on a massive scale. Stocked with the highest quality weapons and tracking equipment, hunters are given high level training in maximizing the quantity and quality of game killed.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:582`

## wildlife_sanctuary

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Awildlife_sanctuary&lang=en)

### 中文

野生动物保护区

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:493`

### English

Wildlife Sanctuary

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:583`

## wildlife_sanctuary_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Awildlife_sanctuary_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这是一个保护区，野生动物在自然栖息地内被研究。这里有保障措施来防止种群不稳定或过度疾病。研究这些生物本身就是一项有价值的学术工作，但最重要的是，它让我们更多地了解我们自己的本质。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:494`

### English

A protected reserve where wild animals are studied within their natural habitats. Safeguards are in place to prevent population instability or excessive disease. Studying these creatures is in itself a worthy academic endeavor, but crucially it teaches us more about our own nature.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:584`

## wildlife_sanctuary_2

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Awildlife_sanctuary_2&lang=en)

### 中文

先进保护区

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:495`

### English

Advanced Sanctuary

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:585`

## wildlife_sanctuary_2_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Awildlife_sanctuary_2_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这里的生物都得到个性化的照顾，它们的独特饮食和医疗需求得到满足，同时最大程度地减少对自然栖息地的干扰。专门的生态系统允许濒危物种的繁殖和重新引入。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:496`

### English

Creatures here are cared for on an individual basis, their unique dietary and medical needs provided with minimal disturbance to their natural habitats. Specialized ecosystems allow for the propagation and reintroduction of endangered species.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:586`

## wildlife_sanctuary_3

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Awildlife_sanctuary_3&lang=en)

### 中文

中枢保护区

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:497`

### English

Sanctuary Nexus

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:587`

## wildlife_sanctuary_3_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Awildlife_sanctuary_3_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这里的动物受到精心设计的、看似不存在的基础设施的监控和照顾。研究人员被禁止干预受试者的自然行为，从而保证收集到质量最高的科研数据。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:498`

### English

Animals here are monitored and cared for using a carefully engineered infrastructure designed to seem as if it doesn't exist. Researchers are forbidden from interfering with the subjects' natural behavior, guaranteeing the collection of the highest possible quality research data.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:588`

## primal_arena

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aprimal_arena&lang=en)

### 中文

野性竞技场

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:499`

### English

Primal Arena

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:589`

## primal_arena_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aprimal_arena_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一座角斗场，我们的最强战士与凶猛的野兽进行原始的战斗。没有什么比观看英雄战胜野兽，或者战死沙场更令人兴奋的娱乐了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:500`

### English

A colosseum where our strongest warriors are pitted against ferocious creatures in primal combat. There is no greater entertainment than watching heroes triumph over savage beasts - or die trying.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:590`

## primal_arena_2

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aprimal_arena_2&lang=en)

### 中文

野性驯兽场

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:501`

### English

Primal Stadium

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:591`

## primal_arena_2_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aprimal_arena_2_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在这座巨大的体育场里，一群群动物在训练有素的驯兽师的指导下，训练着它们的攻击技巧。兽斗士不再能依靠蛮力制服猎物：他们必须比他们的驯兽师更聪明才能生存。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:502`

### English

In this massive stadium, packs of animals are trained by skilled handlers in coordinating their attacks. No longer can beastfighters rely on simply overpowering their quarry: they must use out-think even their trainers in order to survive.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:592`

## primal_arena_3

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aprimal_arena_3&lang=en)

### 中文

野性斗兽场

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:503`

### English

Primal Colosseum

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:593`

## primal_arena_3_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aprimal_arena_3_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一座令人敬畏的竞技场，专为举办史诗级的猎兽战斗而设计。每次战斗都需要数周的准备，可容纳数百万观众。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:504`

### English

An awe-inspiring arena designed to host beast-slaying battles of monumental proportions. Each engagement takes weeks of preparation and can support the attendance of millions of individuals.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:594`

## symbiosis_nexus

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Asymbiosis_nexus&lang=en)

### 中文

共生节点

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:505`

### English

Symbiosis Nodule

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:595`

## symbiosis_nexus_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Asymbiosis_nexus_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一个可以容纳野生伙伴们加入我们大家庭的自然保护区。每个生物都为心灵编织贡献着独特的价值。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:506`

### English

A natural preserve where wild partners are welcomed into our fold. Each creature has something unique to offer the mindweave.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:596`

## symbiosis_nexus_2

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Asymbiosis_nexus_2&lang=en)

### 中文

共生地带

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:507`

### English

Symbiosis Expanse

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:597`

## symbiosis_nexus_2_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Asymbiosis_nexus_2_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一个中央保留地，用于将我们的野生生物伙伴分组到能够自我维持的小种群中。协调他们较低的精神能力，为更大的思维网络提供思想稳定性。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:508`

### English

A central reserve that serves to group our wild partners into self-maintaining pods. Coordinating their lesser mental capacities provides stability of thought to the greater mindweave.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:598`

## symbiosis_nexus_3

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Asymbiosis_nexus_3&lang=en)

### 中文

共生中枢

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:509`

### English

Symbiosis Nexus

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:599`

## symbiosis_nexus_3_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Asymbiosis_nexus_3_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一个广阔的中心枢纽，旨在汇聚所有生物的心智，为我们集体意识提供动力。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:510`

### English

An expansive hub that serves to unite the minds of every creature in powering our collective thought.

## grand_archive.1060.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.1060.name&lang=en)

### 中文

[from.GetSpaceFaunaName]的腐肉

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:532`

### English

[from.GetSpaceFaunaName] Carrion

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:624`

## grand_archive.1060.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.1060.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

与[from.GetSpaceFaunaNamePlural]建立联系后，我们在[fromfrom.GetName]中发现了一具他们物种的腐烂尸体。遗骸在长时间暴露于太空后变得干枯并冻得梆硬。\n\n我们推测这具尸体是吸引了该物种其他成员的首要因素；也许他们一直在寻找他们[from.GetSpaceFaunaGroup]中失踪的成员。这是一个难得的机会，可以研究在虚空中自然死亡的[from.GetSpaceFaunaName]的生物学特性。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:533`

### English

After establishing contact with the [from.GetSpaceFaunaNamePlural], we detected a decaying corpse of one of their kind in [fromfrom.GetName]. The remains are withered and frozen after prolonged exposure to open space.\n\nWe postulate that this carcass is what initially attracted other members of their species; perhaps they had been searching for a lost member of their [from.GetSpaceFaunaGroup]. This is a rare opportunity to study the biology of a [from.GetSpaceFaunaName] that has died of natural causes in the void.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:625`

## NAME_BoneShip_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ANAME_BoneShip_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这艘船装饰着成年的缇扬奇卷须，一排排虚空虫的牙齿，以及一个我们从未见过的生物的头骨。它配备了各种精密武器，显得杀气腾腾。

## grand_archive.1069.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.1069.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们与一艘来自[from.GetName]的奇怪改装太空船取得了联系。$NAME_BoneShip_desc$\n\n在天真地接受了我们的谈判邀请后，这位驾驶员被立即[GetExecuted]。我们已经夺取了他的古怪飞船，并将其加入了我们的军事序列。我们在他的个人物品中发现了一本有用的猎人工具指南。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:549`

### English

We were contacted by a strangely modified spacefaring vessel in [from.GetName]. $NAME_BoneShip_desc$\n\nAfter naively accepting our invitation to parlay, the pilot was summarily [GetExecuted]. We have claimed their peculiar ship and added it to our military ranks. We have discovered a useful hunter's field guide among their personal effects.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:644`

### English

§L"I seek another trophy for my collection."§!

## grand_archive.1075.name

$grand_archive.1070.name$

### English

$grand_archive.1070.name$

## grand_archive.1075.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.1075.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H瑟里兹低沉的声音干涩而沙哑，仿佛已经好几周没有说话了。此人直言不讳，保持着冷静的眼神接触，既显得尊重，又让人感到一丝威慑。§!\n\n作为一名猎物收藏家，要让我印象深刻可不容易。你们做到了。\n\n我愿意加入你们的狩猎队伍，但前提是我们的合作将基于便利和相互学习。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:560`

### English

§HThe brooding Ceriz's voice is dry and cracking, as if they had not spoken in weeks. Their manner is direct and they maintain stoic eye contact in a manner that feels in equal part respectful and intimidating.§!\n\nAs a trophy hunter, it takes a lot to impress me. Your people have.\n\nI am willing to join your hunting parties with the understanding that our partnership will be one of convenience and mutual instruction.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:657`

## grand_archive.1075.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.1075.a&lang=en)

### 中文

你是谁？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:561`

### English

Who are you?

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:658`

## grand_archive.1075.a.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.1075.a.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

我是$NAME_PrimalHunter$，我在这些恒星系中狩猎多年。我正在寻找新的猎物，而你们的人民似乎是能干的追踪者。\n\n我的动机很简单：狩猎的快感。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:562`

### English

I am $NAME_PrimalHunter$. I have hunted within these systems for many years. I seek new quarry, and your people seem to be capable trackers.\n\nMy motivation is simple: the thrill of the hunt.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:659`

## grand_archive.1075.b

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.1075.b&lang=en)

### 中文

你船上的那个颅骨是什么？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:563`

### English

What is that skull on your ship?

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:660`

## grand_archive.1075.b.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.1075.b.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

它是同类中最后的，它奋力抵抗。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:564`

### English

It was the last of its kind. It put up quite a fight.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:661`

## grand_archive.1075.c

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.1075.c&lang=en)

### 中文

你观察我们多久了？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:565`

### English

How long have you been watching us?

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:662`

## grand_archive.1075.c.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.1075.c.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

很明显，你们的人还有很多东西要学。\n\n一个优秀的猎手可以长时间潜行追踪猎物。真正的致命，需要在开枪前保持隐形。我在阴影中度过的时间并不重要，重要的是我选择何时现身。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:566`

### English

It is obvious that your people have much to learn.\n\nA good hunter can track their quarry for as long as required in perfect stealth. To be truly deadly, one must remain unseen until the shot is fired. The time I have spent in the shadows is of no concern, my choice to reveal myself is what counts.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:663`

## grand_archive.1075.d

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.1075.d&lang=en)

### 中文

为什么要加入我们？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:567`

### English

Why join us?

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:664`

## grand_archive.1075.d.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.1075.d.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

我并不寻求在猎场上的竞争。虽然我不愿分享领地，但我宁愿与你的猎手并肩作战，而不愿为同一猎物大打出手。\n\n无论你追踪什么，我都会杀死。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:568`

### English

I seek no competition in the field. Though I am loath to share territory, I would rather work alongside your hunters than fight over the same prey.\n\nWhatever you track, I will kill.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:665`

## grand_archive.1080.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.1080.name&lang=en)

### 中文

漫游的异星生物学家

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:572`

### English

Wandering Xenologist

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:670`

## grand_archive.1080.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.1080.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一艘独立的星际研究船联系了我们位于[from.GetName]的恒星基地。这艘船配备了一系列捕获装置和分析工具，专门用于捕获和研究太空生物。\n\n他们正在所有频率上向我们打招呼。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:573`

### English

We have been contacted by an independent research vessel at our starbase in [from.GetName]. Outfitted with an array of snaring devices and analytical tools, this ship is specifically adapted for the capture and examination of spaceborne life.\n\nThey are hailing us on all frequencies.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:671`

## grand_archive.1080.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.1080.a&lang=en)

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:574`

### English

Open communications.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:672`

## NAME_PrimalRancher

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ANAME_PrimalRancher&lang=en)

### 中文

茹克·恰卜鲁克

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:575`

### English

Ruuk Qabruuk

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:674`

## primal_rancher_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aprimal_rancher_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

她是一位对实地考察充满热情的异星生物学家，研究过各种各样的太空生物。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:576`

### English

A xenologist with a passion for field work, she has studied all manner of spaceborne beasts.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:675`

## primal_rancher_catchphrase

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aprimal_rancher_catchphrase&lang=en)

### 中文

§L“每个生物都有故事要讲，而我是一个热心的倾听者！”§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:577`

### English

§L"Every creature has a story to tell, and I'm a keen listener!"§!

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:676`

## grand_archive.1085.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.1085.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H茹克的眼睛不停地闪烁，注视着一个小巧的手持设备，她那探究和分析的目光让人印象深刻。即使在向我们打招呼时，她也似乎在做着笔记。尽管如此，她的态度还是友好而专业，只是略带疏离。§!\n\n我发现自己对太空生物的兴趣并非孤例。我研究了[root.GetName]正在进行的研究，它简直是启迪人心。我非常希望能加入你们的科学部门，为这些努力贡献力量。当然，如果你们愿意的话。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:578`

### English

§HInquisitive and analytical, Ruuk's eyes flicker constantly to a small, handheld device. Even as she greets us, she appears to be taking notes. Despite that, her manner is cordial and professional, if slightly detached.§!\n\nI see that I'm not alone in my interest in spaceborne creatures. I have studied the research the [root.GetName] has been conducting and it is positively illuminating. I would love nothing more than to aid these efforts as part of your science department. If you'll have me, of course.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:677`

## grand_archive.1085.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.1085.a&lang=en)

### 中文

你是谁？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:579`

### English

Who are you?

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:678`

## grand_archive.1085.a.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.1085.a.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

抱歉，我有点儿太着急了。\n\n我叫茹克，是一名专门研究太空兽群的野外实地考察员。我和我的团队收集有关迁徙模式、身体组成和星系生物多样性的数据。\n\n我从小就喜欢动物。我无论去哪里都带着我的宠物芙芙。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:580`

### English

Sorry, I'm getting ahead of myself.\n\nMy name is Ruuk. I'm a researcher specializing in the field study of spaceborne fauna. My team and I gather data about migration patterns, body composition, and galactic-level biodiversity.\n\nPersonally, I've loved animals since I was a chick. I never go anywhere without Fuluff.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:679`

## grand_archive.1085.b

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.1085.b&lang=en)

### 中文

芙芙？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:581`

### English

Who is Fuluff?

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:680`

## grand_archive.1085.b.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.1085.b.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

整个星系我最爱的小朋友！\n\n我本来想把它展示在屏幕上，但它现在睡着了。在我的家乡行星，我们把这种生物当宠物饲养，我上次回去的时候领养了它。真是太可爱了：听到小蹄子在金属地板上哒哒地跑，啃我的羽毛的样子，还有两只小眼睛之间那撮毛。我相信它也会让你着迷的，当……如果我们开始合作的话。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:582`

### English

Only my favorite guy in the whole galaxy!\n\nI'd show him on-screen, but he's asleep right now. On my home planet, we breed this species as pets and I adopted him on my last visit. He's just the cutest; hearing his little hooves skitter on the metal floors, the way he nibbles on my feathers, the tuft of wool that sticks up between his little eyes. I'm sure he'll win you over too when... if we start working together.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:681`

## grand_archive.1085.c

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.1085.c&lang=en)

### 中文

你是怎么找到我们的？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:583`

### English

How did you find us?

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:682`

## grand_archive.1085.c.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.1085.c.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

我们追踪的一份样本出现了异常行为，于是我们追寻它的踪迹。在那里，我们发现您的科研团队正在与我们的研究对象互动。您对这些生物的细致照料体现了对太空生命的真正尊重，这激励我去了解您的研究，而您的研究更是让我印象深刻。我一直在寻找志同道合的同行。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:584`

### English

One of the specimens we were tracking showed some anomalous behavior, so we followed its trail. There we found your scientific team engaging with our subject. The great care you took with the creatures showed a real respect for spaceborne life, and that inspired me to look into your research, which impressed me even more. I'm always looking for like-minded peers in the field.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:683`

## grand_archive.1085.d

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.1085.d&lang=en)

### 中文

为什么要加入我们？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:585`

### English

Why join us?

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:684`

## grand_archive.1085.d.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.1085.d.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

说实话，自由科学研究并不能可靠地提供收入。我坚信自己的工作，但花费一生寻找资金会占用太多时间，无法专注于核心科学本身。\n\n加入[root.GetName]，我将能够将所有时间投入到我最擅长的领域：研究太空生命。我将获得更多资源，并能与贵国现有的科学团队合作，共同实现我们的目标。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:586`

### English

Honestly, freelance scientific research is not a reliable source of income. I believe in my work, but spending my life looking for funding simply takes too much time away from the core science itself.\n\nBy joining the [root.GetName], I would be able to commit all of my time to do what I do best: studying spaceborne life. I would gain access to greater resources and could collaborate with your existing science team to further our mutual goals.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:685`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.1100.name&lang=en)

### 中文

野兽的锐鸣

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:590`

### English

Bestial Screech

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:690`

## grand_archive.1100.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.1100.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们探测到来自未知空间的大量古怪电磁波。\n\n初步分析表明，这些波动与§Y虚空虫§!的通讯信号相似，但更加不规则，振幅也高得多。我们将对此进行进一步调查。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:591`

### English

We have detected a huge number of peculiar electromagnetic waves coming from uncharted space.\n\nInitial analysis indicates a resemblance to §YVoidworm§! communication signals, albeit more irregular and with a greatly elevated amplitude. This will be investigated further.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:691`

## grand_archive.1100.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.1100.a&lang=en)

### 中文

令人担忧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:592`

### English

Concerning.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:692`

## grand_archive.1105.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.1105.name&lang=en)

### 中文

尖啸的虚空虫

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:593`

### English

Screeching Voidworms

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:694`

## grand_archive.1105.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.1105.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们已经探测到这些动物般的尖叫声的来源：一个隐藏的恒星系，里面住满了§Y虚空虫§!，位于[frenzied_voidworms_target.solar_system.GetName]附近。\n\n这个恒星系中的虚空虫与我们之前遇到的不同。这些生物发生了变异；没有形成三头虫，单个成熟的个体正在进行的行为，只能被描述为狂暴的交配狂欢。\n\n这令人担忧：这种非寄生行为意味着这个虫群可以独立繁殖，无需行星宿主。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:594`

### English

We have detected the source of these animalistic screeches; a hidden system populated by §YVoidworm§! near [frenzied_voidworms_target.solar_system.GetName].\n\nThe Voidworms in this system are unlike those we have encountered previously. These creatures are mutated; there are no troikas formed and the individual mature specimens are engaging in what can only be described as a violent mating frenzy.\n\nThis is concerning: this non-parasitic behavior means this hive can breed independently without the need for planet-borne hosts.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:695`

## grand_archive.1105.desc_no_homicidal

## situation_frenzied_voidworms_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Asituation_frenzied_voidworms_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们发现了一个巨大的、明显发生过变异的虚空虫的巢穴。它们具有高度的攻击倾向，并且似乎能够以非寄生方式繁殖。\n\n我们的存在似乎激怒了它们的巢穴。我们必须谨慎行事。\n\n[GetVoidwormsHostility]

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:600`

### English

We discovered a large hive of obviously mutated Voidworms. They exist in a heightened state of aggression, and apparently have the ability to reproduce in a non-parasitic manner.\n\nOur presence seems to be agitating their nests. We must proceed with caution.\n\n[GetVoidwormsHostility]

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:702`

## grand_archive.1180.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.1180.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在消灭了巢穴附近的一窝虚空虫之后，我们发现这些生物发生了独特的变异。\n\n它们似乎能够以非寄生方式繁殖，并且处于高度攻击状态，这解释了它们非自然的强大和耐久性。\n\n幸运的是，我们保留了一个它们的巢穴作为战利品。在我们控制下，我们可以培育更多这种独特的生物，而不会冒它们不受控制地蔓延到整个星系的风险。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:629`

### English

After eliminating a clutch of Voidworms near their nests, we discovered that these creatures had undergone a unique mutation.\n\nIt seems that they were able to reproduce in a non-parasitic manner and were in a heightened state of aggression, which would explain their unnatural strength and durability.\n\nFortunately, we preserved one of their nests as a trophy. Under our control, we can raise more of these unique creatures without risking their unchecked spread throughout the galaxy.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:736`

我们已经得知，威胁我们殖民地的变异虚空虫已被消灭。\n\n这是一个意外但令人欣慰的结果。我们可以安心的是，这些生物将不再对我们的恒星系构成威胁。

## grand_archive.1205.desc_common

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.1205.desc_common&lang=en)

### 中文

尽管我们尽了最大努力，变异的虚空虫还是彻底摧毁了[this.GetName]。这些狂暴生物的对地轰击太过猛烈，导致行星地核破裂，整个星球最终裂成碎片。没有幸存者。\n\n它们已经回到了巢穴，不再对我们的存在感到激怒。希望它们能一直待在那里。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:638`

### English

Despite our best efforts, the mutated Voidworms have completely overwhelmed [this.GetName]. The frenzied creatures' bombardment was so violent that it cracked the planet's core, causing it to fragment and break apart. There were no survivors.\n\nThey have since returned to their nests and are no longer agitated by our presence. With any luck, they will remain there.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:748`

## grand_archive.1205.desc.default

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.1205.desc.default&lang=en)

### 中文

$grand_archive.1205.desc_common$\n\n面对这场悲剧，我们别无选择，只能继续前进，从错误中吸取教训。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:639`

### English

$grand_archive.1205.desc_common$\n\nWe have no recourse in the face of this tragedy except to live on and learn from our mistakes.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:749`

## grand_archive.1210.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.1210.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在[From.GetName]发现的变异虚空虫已被消灭。[avenged_homeworld.GetName]的毁灭得到了报复。\n\n我们保留了这些奇怪变异生物的巢穴中最大的那一个。在我们控制下，我们可以培育更多这种独特的生物，而不会冒着它们不受控制地蔓延到整个星系的风险。\n\n这样，我们一度失去的世界依旧能够传承下来。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:643`

### English

The mutated Voidworms discovered in [From.GetName] have been eliminated. The destruction of [avenged_homeworld.GetName] has been avenged.\n\nThe largest nest of the strange mutants was preserved. Under our control, we can raise more of these unique creatures without risking their unchecked spread throughout the galaxy.\n\nIn this way, the legacy of our lost world will live on.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:754`

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:646`

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:758`

## grand_archive.1220.desc.common_2

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.1220.desc.common_2&lang=en)

### 中文

我们经验最丰富的动物饲养员一直在努力管理这些野兽，现在它们似乎愿意同我们进行互相合作。\n\n我们已经收容了它们最大的巢穴之一。有了它，我们可以培育更多这些原本会留在野外的变异虚空虫。

Our most experienced animal handlers have been at work managing the beasts, and we are at a point where they seem to be willing to mutually cooperate.\n\nWe have taken in one of their largest nests. With this, we can cultivate more of these mutated Voidworms that would otherwise have been left to the wild.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:759`

## grand_archive.7010.desc.common

### 中文

我们对太空有机生物的掌握促成我们开发出被称之为§Y虚空诱饵§!的东西。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:653`

### English

## grand_archive.7010.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.7010.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$grand_archive.7010.desc.common$\n\n这些恒星基地建筑必须建造在每种特定太空兽群的原生恒星系中。建成后，它们将定期吸引呈舰队般集群的生物前往该恒星基地。\n\n我们应该谨慎，因为某些类型的生物可能会变得具有攻击性。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:654`

### English

$grand_archive.7010.desc.common$\n\nThese starbase buildings must be built within the native systems of each particular kind of Space Fauna. Once established, they will periodically attract fleets of creatures to the starbase.\n\nWe should be cautious, as certain types of organisms could become aggressive.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:767`

## grand_archive.7010.desc.nomadic

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.7010.desc.nomadic&lang=en)

### 中文

$grand_archive.7010.desc.common$\n\n这些模块必须安装在各种太空兽群对应原生恒星系内的驿站上。建成后，它们将周期性地吸引生物种群到驿站来。安装有虚空诱饵阵列的方舟舰可以召唤我们遇到的生物，将它们引诱到任何它们所能栖息的恒星系。\n\n我们应保持警惕，因为某些类型的生物可能会变得具有攻击性。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:655`

### English

$grand_archive.7010.desc.common$\n\nThese modules must be installed on Waystations within the native systems of each particular kind of Space Fauna. Once established, they will periodically attract fleets of creatures to the Waystation. An Arkship equipped with a Voidlure Array may instead call to fauna we have encountered, drawing them to any system that is home to their kind.\n\nWe should be cautious, as certain types of organisms could become aggressive.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:768`

## grand_archive.7010.desc.primal_calling

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.7010.desc.primal_calling&lang=en)

### 中文

$grand_archive.7010.desc.common$\n\n这些设备旨在呼唤太空中的野生生物，吸引在虚空中避难的有机生命体。我们不确定会吸引什么，但目前我们正在广播的频率正在返回规律且镜像的响应。\n\n有东西正向我们而来。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:656`

### English

$grand_archive.7010.desc.common$\n\nThese devices are designed to call into the wilds of space and attract organisms that take shelter in the void. We are not sure what we might attract, but the current frequencies we are broadcasting are returning regular and mirrored responses.\n\nSomething is coming to us.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:769`

## grand_archive.7020.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.7020.name&lang=en)

鲸歌

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:657`

### English

Whalesong

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:771`

## grand_archive.7020.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.7020.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们之前研发的§Y虚空诱饵§!吸引了一群来自其他恒星系的太空鲸鱼，这些恒星系类似[This.Capital.System.GetName]，均含有§Y气态巨行星§!。\n\n看来我们的设备必须在这些环境中建造才能正常工作。如果我们发现其他野生动物，我们应该也能在它们的自然栖息地附近建造虚空诱饵。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:658`

### English

The §YVoidlure§! we had previously developed attracted a group of space whales native to systems with §YGas Giants§! akin to [This.Capital.System.GetName].\n\nIt seems our devices must be built in those environments to work properly. Should we discover other wild fauna, we should be able to construct Voidlures near their natural habitats as well.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:772`

## origin_treasure_hunters_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin_treasure_hunters_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

怀揣着对冒险的渴望，这个文明已经准备好踏上他们最伟大、最具挑战性的探险之旅。他们只手持一张神秘的地图，现在正跨越星辰，去争夺传说中的海盗宝藏。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:661`

### English

Instilled with a thirst for adventure, this civilization is ready to set forth on their greatest and most challenging expedition. Armed only with a mysterious map, they now race across the stars to secure a legendary pirate treasure.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:776`

## START_SCREEN_TREASURE_HUNTERS

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_TREASURE_HUNTERS&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的文明，其本质在于对冒险的渴望。\n\n发现失落的宝藏，探索古老的遗迹，挖掘超越我们时代的文物；这些事件构成了我们最著名的故事，并激励着我们的社会代代相传。\n\n那么，当我们首次进军太空时，出现的冒险号召是巧合还是命运？一颗神秘的、来源不明的太空舱被发现环绕着我们的星球。舱内是一张指向星辰的加密星图。\n\n经过多年的努力，我们终于拥有了解密这张星图并规划航线的技术。当我们向星系边疆进发时，我们团结一致，决心踏上我们有史以来最伟大、最艰巨的探险之旅。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:663`

### English

Our civilization is defined by its thirst for adventure.\n\nDiscovering long-lost treasures, exploring ancient ruins, and unearthing artifacts from times beyond our own; such events comprise our most celebrated stories and have inspired our society for generations.\n\nSo was it coincidence or fate when our first foray into space produced a call to adventure? A mysterious capsule of unknown providence was discovered orbiting our planet. Within was an encrypted chart to the stars.\n\nAfter years of hard work, we now have the technology to decipher this map and chart a course to the unexplored. As we cast off towards the galactic frontier, we are united in our determination to embark on the greatest and most daunting expedition we have ever faced.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:778`

## START_SCREEN_TREASURE_HUNTERS_NOMADS

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_TREASURE_HUNTERS_NOMADS&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的文明以对冒险的热衷而著名。\n\n寻找失传已久的宝藏、探索古老的遗迹、发掘远古时代的遗物……如此种种构成了我们最广为流传的传奇故事，并激励着我们的社会数代人。\n\n那么，当我们在漫无目的中撞见了冒险的召唤，这究竟是巧合还是命运的安排呢？在探索未知星系的过程中，我们找到了一个天意难测的神秘胶囊，里面有一份引向群星的加密星图。\n\n经过多年的研究，我们终于破译了这张星图，并规划出了前往未被探索区域的路线。我们团结一致，朝着星系的边疆启航，决心踏上有史以来最伟大、最艰巨的探险之旅。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:664`

### English

Our civilization is defined by its thirst for adventure.\n\nDiscovering long-lost treasures, exploring ancient ruins, and unearthing artifacts from times beyond our own; such events comprise our most celebrated stories and have inspired our society for generations.\n\nSo was it coincidence or fate when our wanderings led us to a call to adventure? Exploring an uncharted system, we recovered a mysterious capsule of unknown providence. Within was an encrypted chart to the stars.\n\nAfter years of study, we have at last deciphered this map and charted a course to the unexplored. As we cast off towards the galactic frontier, we are united in our determination to embark on the greatest and most daunting expedition we have ever faced.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:779`

## grand_archive.5015.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.5015.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§Y$celestial_chart$§!为我们提供了宝贵的评估信息档案，有助于我们从发现的宝藏中提取更大的价值。我们应该在我们的一个殖民地上建立一座§Y珍宝馆§!，用于对珍贵的小物件进行分类、修复和保存。根据目前的物流情况，以下殖民地适合建造这个新的设施。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:684`

### English

The §Y$celestial_chart$§! has provided us with archived appraisal information useful for extracting greater value from the treasures we discover. We should establish a §YTreasure Vault§! on one of our colonies where valuable trinkets can be sorted, restored, and preserved. Based on current logistics, the following colonies are suitable for this new installation.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:801`

## grand_archive.2000.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.2000.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

传感器检测到[This.System.GetName]星系中存在一个向整个星系发出原始信号的物体。这些相同的信号模式也曾在来自未知区域的长程扫描仪上被记录到。虽然目前尚不清楚这些信号是否具有意图，但需要进一步调查。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:744`

### English

Sensors indicate a presence in the [This.System.GetName] system that is sending rudimentary signals across the galaxy. These same patterns have been registered on long-range scanners originating from parts unknown. Though it is not clear whether these signals are intentional in nature, it warrants further investigation.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:869`

## grand_archive.2005.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.2005.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们发现，这些远距离信号源于一种简单的太空生物，我们将其命名为§H“$NAME_Voidworms$”§!。似乎整个星系都充满了这种生物。根据信号的不同波长，我们确定这些生物在达到最终成熟之前会经历多个生长阶段。虽然它们表面上看起来并不具有攻击性，但它们的交流模式表明它们在星系范围内进行着协调。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:748`

### English

We have discovered that the far-reaching signals originate from a simple spaceborne organism we have taken to calling §H"$NAME_Voidworms$"§!. It appears that the galaxy is riddled with these creatures. From the varying wavelengths of the signals, we have determined that the creatures develop through several stages of growth before reaching final maturity. Though they do not appear outwardly aggressive, their patterns of communication indicate coordination on a galactic scale.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:873`

## grand_archive.2015.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.2015.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

虚空虫以三只为一组交配，这种形态被称为“三头虫”。这些生物的一生都被绑定在永无止境的交配仪式中。然而，它们需要外部生物宿主才能繁殖后代。\n\n它们是寄生虫。\n\n虚空虫成熟后，会在其生殖系统内发育出一窝囊肿。这些保护性囊肿包含高腐蚀性的配子，当与三头虫中的其他配子结合时，可以被发送到具有合适生物量的星球上，以产下更多幼虫。它们的宿主无法在这一过程中存活。我们已经看到证据表明，虚空虫会协调它们的轰炸，以便在整个星系中维持可持续数量的可用宿主。\n\n无论如何，我们相信我们可以利用它们的生殖酶的力量来造福我们自己。我们甚至可以对它们的繁殖活动产生免疫力。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:751`

### English

Voidworms mate in groups of three, a formation known as a "Troika." These creatures become bound for life in a never-ending mating ritual. However, they require an external biological host to produce offspring.\n\nThey are parasites.\n\nUpon reaching maturity, each Voidworm develops a clutch of cysts within their reproductive systems. These protective cysts contain highly caustic gametes that, when combined with others in a Troika, can be sent to planets with suitable biomass in order to give birth to more of their nymphs. Their hosts do not survive this process. We've seen evidence that the Voidworms coordinate their bombardments so as to maintain a sustainable amount of viable hosts throughout the galaxy.\n\nIn any case, we believe that we can harness the power of their reproductive enzymes to our own benefit. We may even develop an immunity to their reproductive efforts.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:876`

## resolution_voidworm_eradication_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_voidworm_eradication_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

有寄生天性的虚空虫是星系的祸害，对有人居住的世界构成威胁。它们的自然生命周期破坏了星系生态系统的平衡，应该被彻底消灭。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:791`

### English

The parasitic Voidworms are a blight on the galaxy and a threat to populated worlds. Their natural lifecycle offsets the balance of the galactic ecosystem and all should be eliminated.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:924`

## resolution_voidworm_eradication_tooltip

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_voidworm_eradication_tooltip&lang=en)

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:792`

### English

Any empire with §Y$NAME_Voidworms$§! inside their borders are in §RBreach of Galactic Law§! until the creatures either leave on their own or are destroyed.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:925`

## grand_archive.2103.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.2103.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]已宣布，所有虚空虫不再被允许进入成员国的恒星系。\n\n在它们被消灭或自行离开我们的宇域之前，[this.GetName]将被视为§R违反星系法§!。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:797`

### English

The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has declared that all Voidworms are no longer permitted within member nation systems.\n\nUntil they are eliminated or leave our space of their own accord, the [this.GetName] will be considered in §RBreach of Galactic Law§!.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:931`

## grand_archive.2105.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.2105.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一支虚空虫舰队已进入[from.GetName]星系内的我们的空间。作为[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]成员，我们有法律义务立即处决在我们边界内的任何虚空虫。\n\n[this.GetName]将被视为§R违反星系法§!，直到虚空虫离开我们的空间或被消灭。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:799`

### English

A fleet of Voidworms has entered our space in the [from.GetName] system. As a [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] member, we are legally obliged to immediately euthanize any Voidworms present within our borders.\n\nThe [this.GetName] will be considered in §RBreach of Galactic Law§! until the Voidworms have either departed our space or are exterminated.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:933`

## grand_archive.2107.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.2107.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

虚空虫一直存在于我们的[invaded_system.GetName]星系，使我们严重§R违反了星系法§!中关于$resolution_voidworm_eradication$决议的内容。这导致[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]允许成员投票对[this.GetName]实施制裁。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:800`

### English

The continued Voidworm presence in our [invaded_system.GetName] system is a significant §RBreach of Galactic Law§! under the $resolution_voidworm_eradication$ resolution. This has resulted in [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] allowing members to vote for sanctions to be imposed on [this.GetName].

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:934`

## grand_archive.2195.desc.common_1

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.2195.desc.common_1&lang=en)

### 中文

[from.GetName]正在遭受攻击。\n\n一大群虚空虫正在殖民地轨道上，用寄生囊肿进行轰炸。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:814`

### English

[from.GetName] is under attack.\n\nA large group of Voidworms is in orbit of the colony, bombarding it with parasitic cysts.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:951`

## grand_archive.2195.desc.common_2

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.2195.desc.common_2&lang=en)

### 中文

生物分析表明，每窝虚空虫都拥有有限数量的囊肿，它们很可能在囊肿耗尽后离开。但在那之前，我们会遭受严重的人口损失。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:815`

### English

Biological analysis indicates that each clutch of Voidworms has a limited supply of these cysts to distribute, and it is likely they will depart once all are depleted. Until then, we are suffering significant population loss.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:952`

## grand_archive.2195.desc.default

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.2195.desc.default&lang=en)

### 中文

$grand_archive.2195.desc.common_1$\n\n每个囊肿都包含一个剧毒孢子，对我们的殖民者以及所有生命都极其致命。一旦被摄入，它会迅速发育成为一只若虫，并会暴力地从宿主体内破茧而出，彻底摧毁宿主。这些若虫体内有一个压缩气体囊，使它们能够上升到高层大气，在那里它们会本能地将自己推进到预定的目的地。\n\n$grand_archive.2195.desc.common_2$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:816`

### English

$grand_archive.2195.desc.common_1$\n\nEach cyst contains a toxic spore that is extremely deadly not only to our colonists, but all life. Once ingested, it rapidly gestates into a nymph that will emerge violently and completely destroy its host. These nymphs contain a bladder of compressed gases that allows them to ascend the upper atmosphere, where they instinctively propel themselves to a predetermined destination.\n\n$grand_archive.2195.desc.common_2$

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:953`

## grand_archive.2195.desc.rocks

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.2195.desc.rocks&lang=en)

### 中文

$grand_archive.2195.desc.common_1$\n\n每个囊肿都包含一个剧毒孢子，对所有本地动物群都极其致命。一旦被摄入，它会迅速发育成为一只若虫，并会暴力地从宿主体内破茧而出，彻底摧毁宿主。这些若虫通常以小行星为食，以获取珍贵的金属，但它们也会伺机捕食我们脆弱的[this.GetColonistPlural]。每个幼虫体内都含有一个压缩气体囊，使它们能够上升到高层大气，并本能地将自己推进到预定的目的地。\n\n$grand_archive.2195.desc.common_2$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:817`

### English

$grand_archive.2195.desc.common_1$\n\nEach cyst contains a toxic spore that is extremely deadly to all native fauna. Once ingested, it rapidly gestates into a nymph that will emerge violently and completely destroy its host. The nymphs, which normally feed on asteroids for their precious metals, opportunistically hunt and feed upon our vulnerable [this.GetColonistPlural].  Each hatchling contains a bladder of compressed gases that allows them to ascend to the upper atmosphere, where they instinctively propel themselves to a predetermined destination.\n\n$grand_archive.2195.desc.common_2$

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:954`

## grand_archive.2310.desc.default

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.2310.desc.default&lang=en)

### 中文

星系中$NAME_Voidworms$的数量已达到临界值，它们的习性正在发生显著变化。\n\n它们生命周期中原本会放任宿主物种繁衍一段时间的阶段已打破，它们似乎不再顾及这些产卵地是否能够维持可持续性。\n\n我们所有殖民地都已进入红色警戒状态。在任何星系中发现$NAME_Voidworms$，都应极其谨慎地应对。\n\n一场泛星系级的繁殖狂潮正在向我们袭来。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:831`

### English

The population of $NAME_Voidworms$ in the galaxy has reached a critical mass. Their behavior is noticeably changing.\n\nThe typical stage of their lifecycle where host populations would be spared has been disrupted. There seems to be no further regard for the sustainability of their spawning grounds.\n\nAll of our colonies are on red alert. The presence of $NAME_Voidworms$ in any system should be met with extreme caution.\n\nA breeding frenzy on the galactic scale is upon us.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:972`

## grand_archive.2310.desc.tech

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.2310.desc.tech&lang=en)

### 中文

$grand_archive.2310.desc.default$\n\n我们之前针对这些寄生虫建立的免疫力，现在已经不再像以前那样有效了。我们需要重新开始研究。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:832`

### English

$grand_archive.2310.desc.default$\n\nThe immunity we have previously developed against these parasites is no longer working to the same degree. We will need to go back to the drawing board.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:973`

## grand_archive.2310.desc.nocontact

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.2310.desc.nocontact&lang=en)

### 中文

整个星系都在疯传一个令人不安的消息：一种此前不为人知的太空兽群“虚空虫”正在疯狂繁殖。据说，对于那些防御系统不够完善的恒星系来说，这些生物构成了巨大的威胁。我们所有的殖民地现在都已经进入了最高警戒状态。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:833`

### English

Disturbing reports are being intercepted across the galaxy that a previously unknown species of space fauna known as "Voidworms" have entered a reproductive frenzy. These creatures are reportedly a significant threat to planets without adequate system defenses. All of our colonies are now on red alert.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:974`

## grand_archive.2400.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.2400.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们在对抗$NAME_Voidworms$的行动中，由于改良了维护协议，舰队支援力度提升，意外获得了大量额外的零件。我们有机会将这些材料投入到提高新舰队的短期生产中。

### English

Our increased fleet support in efforts against the $NAME_Voidworms$ has yielded an unexpected windfall of additional components due to improved maintenance protocols. We have an opportunity to invest these materials into improving our short-term production of new fleets.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1001`

## grand_archive.2405.desc.default

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.2405.desc.default&lang=en)

### 中文

我们持之以恒抵御虚空虫威胁的准备工作，激励了新一代的指挥官。[this.GetName]的经验丰富的公民选择贡献他们的才能，以消除这个全星系的威胁。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:860`

### English

Our continued preparations against the Voidworm menace has inspired a new generation of Commanders. Experienced citizens of [this.GetName] have chosen to offer their talents toward the elimination of this galactic threat.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1006`

## grand_archive.2405.desc.gestalt

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.2405.desc.gestalt&lang=en)

### 中文

我们针对虚空虫威胁进行了持续的准备工作，使我们能够生产出额外的指挥官级领袖节点。由于我们为舰队提供额外的支援，这些战斗型节点能够获得更多资源，以促进其快速融入我们的军事行动之中。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:861`

### English

Our continued preparations against the Voidworm menace has allowed us to produce additional Commander-class leadership nodes. By providing additional support to our fleets, these Combat-focused nodes have received increased resources to facilitate their swift integration into our military efforts.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1007`

### English
