## grand_archive.2410.desc.default

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.2410.desc.default&lang=en)

### 中文

驻扎在[random_shipyard.GetName]的工程师开发了一种新的舰船防御概念蓝图。[random_shipyard.leader.GetHeSheCap]在对抗虚空虫的战斗中进行例行维修时，[random_shipyard.leader.GetHeShe]灵机一动，想出了一个可以提高舰船坚固性的新组件。该想法提交给我们的研究部门后，我们认为它具有巨大的潜力。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:865`

### English

An engineer stationed on [random_shipyard.GetName] has developed a new conceptual blueprint for ship defenses. [random_shipyard.leader.GetHeSheCap] was carrying out routine repairs in the fight against the Voidworms when [random_shipyard.leader.GetHeShe] came up with an idea for a new component that would increase the hardiness of our vessels. After the idea was presented to our research department, we believe that it has great potential.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1012`

## grand_archive.2410.desc.gestalt

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.2410.desc.gestalt&lang=en)

### 中文

驻扎在[random_shipyard.GetName]的维修[root.GetIndividualName]激发了新的研究观点，能够改进舰船防御。在例行维修期间的一次误操作中，该[root.GetIndividualName]使用了一种奇特的材料和方法组合，创造了一种新的防护组件。经过对研究可能性进行论证，这一意外发现经过改进后可以展现出巨大潜力。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:866`

### English

A repair [root.GetIndividualName] stationed on [random_shipyard.GetName] has inspired new research insights to improve ship defenses. After a miscommunication during routine repairs, the [root.GetIndividualName] used a peculiar combination of methods and materials to create a new protective component. After investigating the research possibilities, this accidental discovery has shown great potential once refined.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1013`

## grand_archive.2420.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.2420.name&lang=en)

### 中文

### English

[infected_leader.GetName] Infected

## grand_archive.2420.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.2420.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在履行[infected_leader.GetHisHer]的职责期间，[infected_leader.GetName]感染了活跃的虚空虫孢子。新的若虫很快就会出现并摧毁它们的宿主。\n\n这可能是一场徒劳的战斗，但医务人员推测，在幼虫完全融入[infected_leader.GetHisHer]的神经系统之前，可能可以将其取出。这是一场风险很大的手术，但[infected_leader.GetName]似乎愿意让我们尝试。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:868`

### English

In the performance of [infected_leader.GetHisHer] duties, [infected_leader.GetName] [infected_leader.GetHasHave] become infected with active Voidworm spores. It will not be long until new nymphs emerge and destroy their host.\n\nIt could be a lost cause, but the medical staff speculate it may be possible to extract the larva before they have fully integrated into [infected_leader.GetHisHer] nervous system. It's a risky procedure, but [infected_leader.GetName] seems willing to let us try.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1016`

### English

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1033`

## grand_archive.2430.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.2430.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

虽然清除感染者被认为是最明智的行动方针，但许多士兵却难以执行命令。尽管虚空虫的寄生虫危险性很高，但许多士兵仍然无法为了更大的利益而消灭自己的同胞。\n\n必须采取措施阻止虚空虫感染在我们的殖民地蔓延。我们可以尝试将清除过程的某些环节自动化，从而减少对士兵的需求。或者，我们可以发起短暂的宣传活动，宣传我们清除行动的道德标准，并重申其必要性。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:884`

### English

While it is agreed that purging the infected is the wisest course of action, many soldiers are struggling to carry out orders. Despite the danger of the Voidworm parasite, many are simply unable to eliminate their fellow citizens for the greater good.\n\nSomething must be done to prevent the Voidworm infection from spreading through our colonies. We may be able to automate certain parts of the purging process so as to require fewer soldiers. Alternatively, we can launch a short publicity campaign to promote the ethical standards of our purging efforts and reaffirm their necessity.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1034`

## grand_archive.2430.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.2430.a&lang=en)

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:885`

### English

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1035`

## grand_archive.2430.b

## grand_archive.2440.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.2440.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们对虚空虫瘟疫的治疗方法的探索，也促进了其他生物学领域的平行研究。虽然寄生虫目前仍是我们的首要任务，但这一新的突破在未来研究中具有巨大潜力。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:888`

### English

Our search for the cure to the Voidworm plague has allowed research in other biological fields to progress in parallel. While the parasites remain our current priority, this new breakthrough has tremendous potential for future study.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1039`

## grand_archive.2445.desc.common

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.2445.desc.common&lang=en)

### 中文

我们对虚空虫疫的理解正在提高，并且已经开发出治愈方法的基础。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:890`

### English

Our understanding of the Voidworm Plague is improving and the foundation of a cure has been developed.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1042`

## grand_archive.2445.desc.default

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.2445.desc.default&lang=en)

### 中文

$grand_archive.2445.desc.common$然而，如果能在[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]参与者身上进行早期活体测试，我们的研究进度将会快得多。\n\n撇开伦理考量不谈，为了更大的利益，绕过某些安全措施或许是明智之举。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:891`

### English

$grand_archive.2445.desc.common$ However, our research could progress at a much quicker pace with early-stage live testing on [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] participants.\n\nEthical considerations aside, it may be wiser to bypass certain safety measures for the sake of the greater good.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1043`

## grand_archive.2445.desc.gestalt

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.2445.desc.gestalt&lang=en)

### 中文

$grand_archive.2445.desc.common$然而，测试过程非常耗时，主要原因是需要不断地将未分配的[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]作为测试对象。如果[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]可以简单地重新分配成为测试对象，那么治愈方案的开发速度将会加快。\n\n然而，这种做法会对整个集体造成其他影响，重新分配的[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]将导致其先前角色陷入混乱。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:892`

### English

$grand_archive.2445.desc.common$ However, the testing process is time-consuming, primarily due to the constant need for idle [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] as subjects. If [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] could simply be reassigned to become test subjects, the cure would develop at a faster rate.\n\nThe consequences would be felt elsewhere throughout the collective, with reassigned [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] leaving their previous role in disarray.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1044`

### 中文

虚空虫腺体

### English

Voidworm Glands

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1051`

## grand_archive.2450.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.2450.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们发现了虚空虫繁殖周期中的一个规律，这可能在合成治疗虚空虫疫的药物方面带来重大突破。\n\n为了验证这一假设，必须从一只野生$voidworms_titan$中采集其生殖腺进行分析。至关重要的是，这只$voidworms_titan$必须在轰炸星球的过程中被杀死，才能保存活跃的生殖配子。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:899`

### English

We have discovered a pattern in the reproduction cycle of Voidworms that could lead to a huge breakthrough in synthesizing a cure to the Voidworm Plague.\n\nTo confirm this hypothesis, the reproductive glands of a wild $voidworms_titan$ must be harvested for analysis. Crucially, this $voidworms_titan$ must be killed while bombarding a planet in order to preserve the active reproductive gametes.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1052`

### 中文

我们在寻找虚空虫疫的治疗方法方面取得了突破性进展。唯一需要的是处于活跃繁殖状态的虚空三头虫的生殖腺。

## VOIDWORM_TITAN_DEBRIS_PROJECT_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AVOIDWORM_TITAN_DEBRIS_PROJECT_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

这种虚空三头虫的残骸可以收获其具有繁殖能力的生殖腺。\n\n这些器官将极大地扩展我们对这些生物的生物学理解，并帮助我们彻底消灭虚空虫疫。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:906`

### English

The remains of this Voidworm Troika can be harvested for their fertile reproductive glands.\n\nThese organs would greatly expand our understanding of the creatures' biology and assist in eradicating the Voidworm Plague once and for all.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1061`

## grand_archive.2455.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.2455.name&lang=en)

### 中文

取回腺体

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:907`

### English

Glands Recovered

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1063`

## grand_archive.2455.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.2455.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

从可育的“三头虫”形态的虚空虫身上取回的腺体揭示关于它们生殖循环的新信息。\n\n每一只处于繁殖拥抱中的虚空虫都会将遗传物质均匀分布，有效地形成一个全新的有机体，深锁于交配仪式中直到死亡。\n\n我们可以利用这些展现出遗传延展性的过程来对付他们。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:908`

### English

The glands recovered from the fertile Voidworm Troika revealed new information about their reproductive cycles.\n\nLocked in a mating ritual until death, each of the three Voidworms in reproductive embrace distribute their genetic material equally between themselves, effectively becoming a new organism entirely.\n\nWe can use these processes of genetic malleability against them.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1064`

## grand_archive.2500.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.2500.name&lang=en)

### 中文

发现治疗方法

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:909`

### English

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1066`

## grand_archive.2500.desc.default

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.2500.desc.default&lang=en)

### 中文

我们终于研制出了彻底根治虚空虫寄生感染的方法。从此以后，我们的殖民地再也不用担心那些可怕的孢子袭击了，星系中这些虫子的存在也不再是我们需要操心的问题了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:910`

### English

We have completed the development of an ultimate cure to the Voidworm parasitic infection. Our colonies are no longer susceptible to their spore bombardments, and we need no longer be concerned about their presence in the galaxy.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1067`

## grand_archive.2500.desc.tech

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.2500.desc.tech&lang=en)

$grand_archive.2500.desc.default$\n\n我们确信，这一次，我们开发的治疗方法已经能够防范他们生物学上的任何未来突变。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:911`

### English

$grand_archive.2500.desc.default$\n\nWe are certain that, this time, the cure we have developed is safeguarded against any future mutation of their biology.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1068`

## resolution_cutholoid_eradication_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_cutholoid_eradication_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

不应该容许吞噬舰船的岩居兽在文明的星系内存在。必须不惜一切代价消灭这些生物。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:951`

### English

Vessel-devouring Cutholoids should not be permitted to exist freely within civilized systems. These creatures must be exterminated at all costs.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1114`

## resolution_cutholoid_eradication_tooltip

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_cutholoid_eradication_tooltip&lang=en)

### 中文

任何国境内有§Y$cutholoids_plural$§!居住的国家都将被视作§R违反星系法§!，直到这些生物被彻底摧毁。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:952`

### English

Any empire with §Y$cutholoids_plural$§! inside their borders are in §RBreach of Galactic Law§! until the creatures are destroyed.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1115`

## grand_archive.3103.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.3103.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]已宣布，所有岩居兽不再被允许进入成员国的恒星系。\n\n在它们被消灭或自行离开我们的宇域之前，[Root.GetName]将被视为§R违反星系法§!。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:959`

### English

The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has declared that Cutholoids are no longer permitted within member nation systems.\n\nOnce discovered, these creatures must be destroyed, else the [Root.GetName] will be considered in §RBreach of Galactic Law§!.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1124`

## grand_archive.3105.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.3105.name&lang=en)

### 中文

[this.GetSpeciesName]宇域内的$cutholoids_plural$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:960`

### English

$cutholoids_plural$ In [this.GetSpeciesName] Space

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1125`

## grand_archive.3105.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.3105.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[from.GetName]恒星系内发现了一只岩居兽。在[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]将其指定为危险害兽之后，成员国有法律义务立即处决在边界内的所有岩居兽。\n\n[Root.GetName]将被视为§R违反星系法§!，直到岩居兽离开我们的星系或被消灭为止。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:961`

### English

A Cutholoid has been discovered in the [from.GetName] system. Following their designation as a dangerous pest, all [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] members are legally obliged to immediately euthanize any Cutholoids present within their borders.\n\nThe [Root.GetName] will be considered in §RBreach of Galactic Law§! until the Cutholoid has been exterminated or otherwise driven from our systems.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1126`

## grand_archive.3107.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.3107.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

岩居兽一直存在于我们的[invaded_system.GetName]星系，使我们严重§R违反了星系法§!中关于$resolution_cutholoid_eradication$决议的内容。这导致[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]允许成员投票对[Root.GetName]实施制裁。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:962`

### English

The continued Cutholoid presence in our [invaded_system.GetName] system is a significant §RBreach of Galactic Law§! under the $resolution_cutholoid_eradication$ resolution. This has resulted in [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] allowing members to vote for sanctions to be imposed on [Root.GetName].

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1127`

## grand_archive.3011.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.3011.name&lang=en)

### 中文

科研船失踪

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:963`

### English

Science Ship Missing

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1129`

## grand_archive.3011.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.3011.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的一艘科研船在[cutholoid_under_radar.solar_system.GetName]调查一颗奇怪的小行星时失去了联系。\n\n在他们最后失踪的地点探测到了微弱的应急信号，我如果要找回这艘失踪的舰船就需要进一步调查。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:964`

### English

Contact has been lost with our Science Ship while investigating a strange asteroid in [cutholoid_under_radar.solar_system.GetName].\n\nWe are detecting weak emergency signals from their last known location, and should investigate further if we intend to recover the missing vessel.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1130`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.3011.a&lang=en)

太糟了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:965`

### English

This is bad.

## grand_archive.3012.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.3012.name&lang=en)

### 中文

发现小行星实体

### English

Asteroidal Entity Discovered

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1133`

## grand_archive.3012.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.3012.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在§H[from.solar_system.GetName]§!进行例行探索的过程中发现了另一个奇怪的小行星状生物。\n\n我们应该避免让§H科研船§!接近这个星系，直到我们对这个危险的物体有更多的了解为止。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:967`

### English

Another of the strange asteroidal creatures have been discovered in §H[from.solar_system.GetName]§! during routine exploration.\n\nWe should avoid this system with our §HScience Ships§! until we know more about these dangerous objects.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1134`

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:968`

### English

Continue investigations.

## grand_archive.3016.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.3016.name&lang=en)

### 中文

令人不快的意外

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:969`

### English

An Unpleasant Surprise

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1137`

## grand_archive.3016.desc.default

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.3016.desc.default&lang=en)

### 中文

[fromfrom.GetName]中的小行星只是一只栖居在里面的巨大有机体的外壳。\n\n我们成功地将其摧毁，并找回了[this.GetName]。此后调查小行星的时候可得小心了。\n\n可能还有其他的这种生物潜藏于此，等待着不小心的猎物。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:970`

### English

The asteroid in [fromfrom.GetName] served only as a shell for a massive organism living inside.\n\nWe have successfully destroyed it and recovered [this.GetName]. Caution should be taken in further investigations of asteroids.\n\nMore of these creatures may be out there, lying in wait of easy prey.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1138`

## grand_archive.3016.desc.leader_killed

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.3016.desc.leader_killed&lang=en)

### 中文

$grand_archive.3016.desc.default$不幸的是，[leader.GetName]遭受到了一些不可修复的损伤。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:971`

### English

$grand_archive.3016.desc.default$ Unfortunately, [leader.GetName] suffered some irreparable harm.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1139`

## grand_archive.3018.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.3018.name&lang=en)

### 中文

兽口脱险

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:972`

### English

From the Belly of the Beast

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1141`

## grand_archive.3018.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.3018.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们在§H[current_system.GetName]§!失踪的科研船回来了！\n\n§H[leader.GetName]§!发回的报道称，他们被一个藏在小行星中的太空实体整个吞下，最后在船体就要承受不住的时候意外地被吐了出来。似乎有什么别的东西把这个生物吓了一跳让我们侥幸逃脱。\n\n在有更多的认知之前，探索这片小行星带可要多加小心了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:973`

### English

Our Science Ship lost in §H[current_system.GetName]§! has returned!\n\nReports have come in from §H[leader.GetName]§! that they had been swallowed whole by a spaceborne entity hiding inside of an asteroid, and were at the limits of hull integrity before being unexpectedly ejected to safety. It appears something else has surprised the creature before we could intervene.\n\nWe should be cautious in our approach of certain asteroid belts until we can learn more.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1142`

## grand_archive.3018.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.3018.a&lang=en)

### 中文

真幸运。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:974`

### English

How fortunate.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1143`

## grand_archive.3020.name

失去科研船

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:975`

### English

Science Ship Lost

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1145`

## grand_archive.3020.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.3020.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[from.GetName]的应急通讯戛然而止。我们只能相信[from.GetName]科研船已经永远离我们而去了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:976`

### English

The emergency transmissions from [from.GetName] have ceased. We can only assume the science ship [from.GetName] has been lost for good.

## grand_archive.2800.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.2800.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

## grand_archive.2900.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.2900.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们发现了一种居住在小行星外壳内的太空生物，将其命名为§H岩居兽§!。它们是一种可以埋伏数年只为给猎物致命一击的伏击掠食者。它们极度危险，能吞下整艘舰船，所以在探索那些未调查的小行星带时务必格外小心。\n\n好消息是，它们的数量非常稀少，而且无性繁殖流程可能要花费上百年。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:990`

### English

We have discovered a spaceborne organism that shelters inside of asteroids. Known to us as "§HCutholoids§!", these creatures are ambush predators that are capable of lying in wait for several years to capture their prey. Capable of engulfing entire ships, we should be very careful when approaching unsurveyed asteroid belts as they are found to be extremely dangerous.\n\nThe good news is that they appear to be quite rare, and their asexual reproductive processes can take hundreds of years.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1165`

### English

Cutholoid Shells

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1170`

## grand_archive.2905.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.2905.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

岩居兽的外壳并不只是矿物而已，其中还有生物纤维补强。这些纤维一直都在生长，这种外壳中估计包含了超过一半的生物质。\n\n当岩居兽长得住不下小行星时，他们会寻找下一个新家并再次开始整合流程。虽然它们通常具有很强的领地意识，但在极佳的外壳候选品的轨道上也会出现多只岩居兽，其中最大的一只将占据这颗新的小行星，而其他个体将按大小排序，和平地交换外壳。通过这种方式，它们居住的小行星往往会交换十几手之多。\n\n最终的结果是，最小的小行星会因为交换频繁反而得到了最多的生物强化。这些样品具有重要的科学价值。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:995`

### English

The shell of a Cutholoid is not mineral alone, but reinforced with strong biological fibers. These fibers never stop growing, and the composition of some shells is estimated to be over fifty percent biomass.\n\nWhen a Cutholoid grows too large for its asteroid, it will seek another home and begin the integration process again. While they are normally highly territorial, multiple Cutholoids have been observed in orbit of a prime shell candidate. The largest of the creatures will occupy the fresh asteroid, while others will order themselves by size and peacefully swap with the next in line. In this way, the asteroids they inhabit have often been occupied by dozens of previous organisms.\n\nThe end result is that the smallest asteroids have the highest amount of biological reinforcement, as they have been exchanged most often. These samples contain significant scientific value.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1171`

## r_flowmetal_alloy_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ar_flowmetal_alloy_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这种自我复制的材料可以增强它接触到的任何金属的化学键。将流金属整合到我们的组装流程中可以极大地提高大型机器的生产效率。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1216`

### English

This self-replicating material fortifies the chemical bonds of any metal it comes in contact with. Integrating flowmetal into our assembly process can greatly enhance large-scale machine production.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1438`

## r_crystallinus_diffuser_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ar_crystallinus_diffuser_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一种能够将合成晶体转化为极强效的性能增强药物的机器。其产生的化学物质在最纯净的形式下具有生物挥发性，并可能导致一小部分使用者出现多器官功能衰竭。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1219`

### English

A machine capable of converting synthesized crystals into an extremely potent performance-enhancing drug. In its purest form, the resulting chemical is biologically volatile and can cause multiple organ system failure in a small percentage of its users.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1442`

## r_everchanging_stone_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ar_everchanging_stone_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一种经过工程设计的宝石，其颜色和化学成分会根据周围环境发生变化。当它被放置在任何物体旁边时，它会模仿该物体材料的元素，使我们能够更好地理解该物体的分子组成。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1226`

### English

An engineered gemstone that shifts in color and chemical composition based on its surroundings. When placed next to any object, it mimics elements of its material and allows us to better understand the subject's molecular composition.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1450`

Pulsestone

## r_pulsestone_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ar_pulsestone_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一种高放射性石头，会产生危险的磁力波。它有可能彻底改变我们对场操控的理解，但它释放的能量几乎无法控制。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1230`

### English

A highly radioactive stone which creates dangerous waves of magnetic force. It has the potential to revolutionize our understanding of field manipulation, but the energy it emits is almost impossible to contain.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1455`

## r_gavel_of_the_tribunal_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ar_gavel_of_the_tribunal_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这把槌柄上刻着古代三巨头智者的名字，他们曾统治着一个如今已消亡的星系。虽然它对于我们任何人都过于庞大，无法握持，但它仅仅存在就足以让人敬畏。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1234`

### English

Inscribed on the handle of this gavel are the names of an ancient triumvirate of minds which governed a now dead galaxy. Though it is far too large for any of our kind to wield, its mere presence evokes no small amount of awe.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1460`

## r_prototype_vir_core_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ar_prototype_vir_core_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

件独立的人工智能特别擅长教育和指导，能够在各种情况下提供帮助。它擅长于深入浅出的解释复杂概念、清晰地阐述信息，以让用户做出明智的决定。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1249`

### English

This isolated Artificial Intelligence is a particularly effective teacher and mentor, able to assist in almost every situation. It excels in describing complicated explanations in simple terms, laying out information clearly to allow the user to make well-informed decisions.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1478`

## r_propagandosphere_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ar_propagandosphere_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这个全息球体包含着一个已消失文明的宣传电影档案。这些电影创意非凡，引人入胜，可以根据我们的形象重新制作，以激励我们的军队和人民。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1252`

### English

This holographic sphere contains an archive of propaganda films from a bygone civilization. Incredibly inventive and enthralling to watch, they could be remade in our image to inspire our troops and people.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1482`

## r_executus_compendium

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ar_executus_compendium&lang=en)

### 中文

### English

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1484`

## r_executus_compendium_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ar_executus_compendium_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一个古老文明的议会留下了大量记录，这些记录被封存在一个密封的胶囊中。太空舱内包含数万亿页详细记载，记录着官僚机构的优化和创新的组织工具。其中许多改进可以应用到我们自己的政府流程中。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1254`

### English

These extensive records of an ancient civilization's council were preserved in a sealed capsule. Within its trillions of pages are detailed accounts of bureaucratic optimizations and innovative organizational tools. Many of these improvements could be implemented in our own government processes.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1485`

### English

## r_the_pattern_maker_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ar_the_pattern_maker_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这台古老的计算器拥有无与伦比的监测动态轨迹和预测敌舰等物体行为的能力。其预测算法生成的数据模式如同大师级建筑师的设计般深邃复杂。在提供充足的能量和材料的情况下，它可以制造出一艘配备高性能传感器的专用侦察舰。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1257`

### English

This ancient calculator has an unrivaled ability to monitor dynamic trajectories and predict how objects such as enemy ships will behave. The data patterns generated from its prediction algorithms are as deeply layered as a master architect's designs. When given sufficient power and materials, it can produce a specialized scouting vessel equipped with high-powered sensors.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1489`

## r_the_pattern_maker_effect_tt

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ar_the_pattern_maker_effect_tt&lang=en)

## r_vaporous_mega_orchid_desc

### 中文

这种特别巨大的兰花每50年才开花一次。它的香味已被证明具有镇定作用，可以暂时阻断相关大脑神经突触，避免攻击和不信任的行径。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1263`

### English

This particularly massive orchid blooms only once every 50 years. Its aroma has been shown to have an mollifying effect, temporarily blocking the mental synapses that cause aggression and distrust.

## r_tiyanki_matriarch_nerve_core_desc

### 中文

这一远古太空鲸鱼的脑物质中，用神经元编码储存了无数世纪的演化数据。通过解码其网络，我们就能发现其他巨型猎食者的弱点，揭开它们生存方式的秘密。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1267`

### English

The brain matter of this ancient space whale contains centuries of evolutionary data encoded with its neurons. By decoding its network, we're able to find vulnerabilities in other super predators, as well as unlock the secrets of their survival.

## CURATORS_STAGE_1_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ACURATORS_STAGE_1_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

你们初步的收藏令人印象深刻，我们愿意为你们服务。为了星系的保护工作，我们将派遣一名专家在你所选领域提供协助。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1337`

### English

Your initial collection is impressive, and we'd like to offer our services. In the interest of galactic preservation, we will dispatch a specialist to assist you in the area of your choosing.

## grand_archive.4135.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.4135.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

随着我们继续在这个星球上净化那些肮脏的异星渣滓，我们的[GetCollectionRewardCategory]战利品收集愈发充盈。\n\n希望这些展品能成为这个污秽星系的残骸，进一步激励我们履行誓言。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1404`

### English

As we continue our efforts to cleanse this world of filthy xeno scum, our collection of [GetCollectionRewardCategory] trophies has grown.\n\nMay these exhibits serve as the carcass of this contaminated galaxy and further inspire us in our sworn mission.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1662`

## grand_archive.4140.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.4140.name&lang=en)

### 中文

攒奇藏珍

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1408`

### English

Amassed Baubles

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1667`

## grand_archive.4140.desc.geology

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.4140.desc.geology&lang=en)

### 中文

我们继续从这个肮脏的恒星系中收集[GetCollectionRewardCategory]物品，奇珍异宝和古怪的东西。\n\n让我们花点时间欣赏我们的战利品，但要知道，外面还有更多东西等着我们去获取。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1409`

### English

We continue to amass [GetCollectionRewardCategory] objects, baubles and oddities from this filthy galaxy.\n\nLet us take a moment to admire our trophies, but know that there is so much more out there to take.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1668`

## grand_archive.4140.desc.aesthetic

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.4140.desc.aesthetic&lang=en)

### 中文

我们继续收集[GetCollectionRewardCategory]饰品，这些饰品是低等生命形式播下的污染的残余。\n\n一旦所有令人作呕的异形都被从星空中清除，这些物品将提醒我们它们低等的本质。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1410`

### English

We continue to amass [GetCollectionRewardCategory] trinkets, remnants of the contamination that has been sown by inferior lifeforms.\n\nOnce every disgusting xeno has been purged from the stars, these items will remind us of their inferior nature.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1669`

## grand_archive.4140.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.4140.a&lang=en)

### 中文

这个星系必须净化。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1411`

### English

This galaxy must be cleansed.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1670`

## grand_archive.4145.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.4145.name&lang=en)

### 中文

满载战利品

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1412`

### English

Trophy Case Filled

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1672`

## grand_archive.4145.desc.geology

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.4145.desc.geology&lang=en)

### 中文

我们已经用[GetCollectionRewardCategory]的物品填满了我们的仓库，这些是这个星系的古老血肉。\n\n我们认为这庞大的收藏是记录我们毁灭一切的证明。让所有人都见证我们的胜利。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1413`

### English

We have filled our stores with [GetCollectionRewardCategory] objects, the ancient flesh of this galaxy.\n\nWe consider this vast collection to be a record of our destruction of it all. Let all gaze upon our triumphs.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1673`

## grand_archive.4145.desc.aesthetic

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.4145.desc.aesthetic&lang=en)

### 中文

我们已经用[GetCollectionRewardCategory]奇物填满了我们的仓库，这些奇物是毫无意义的外星装饰品的宝库。\n\n我们看着这庞大的收藏，嘲笑我们那些可怜的低等生物。想想吧，一旦他们被消灭，这些展示柜将是他们留下的唯一遗迹。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1414`

### English

We have filled our stores with [GetCollectionRewardCategory] curios, a veritable wealth of meaningless xeno ornaments.\n\nWe look upon this vast collection and laugh at the pitiful nature of our inferiors. To think, once they have been exterminated, these display cases will be all that remain of them.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1674`

为死亡干杯！

### English

饥饿并未消退。在我们吞噬的征途中，[GetCollectionRewardCategory]奇物的收藏不断增长。\n\n愿这些展品成为我们吞噬的星系的最后记忆。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1418`

The hunger does not wane. Our collection of [GetCollectionRewardCategory] curios has grown during our campaign of consumption.\n\nMay these exhibits serve as the last memories of the galaxy we have devoured.

Once this galaxy has been devoured in full, we will look upon these items and savor the memories of taste.

Vivarium Repopulation Project

## grand_archive.4580.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.4580.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

新的$grand_archive$业已在[from.GetName]建成，我们有机会重建在生态园所失去的大部分东西。\n\n我们从之前养育的太空兽群物种身上采集的基因物质都有妥善保存，只要有足够的资源就可以克隆出新的幼体。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1488`

### English

Now that a new $grand_archive$ has been established in [from.GetName], we have an opportunity to restore much of what was lost from our Vivarium.\n\nGenetic Material from each Space Fauna species we have previously raised has been preserved, and with enough resources we can clone new hatchlings.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1760`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ATREASURE_TROVE_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

在[this.GetName]内的某处探测到了一个失踪已久的海盗§Y$TREASURE_TROVE$§!。谁也不知道里面到底藏有多少宝贝……

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1569`

### English

A long-lost pirate's §Y$TREASURE_TROVE$§! has been detected to be somewhere on [this.GetName]. Who knows what riches it may contain...

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1853`

## treasure_troves_chain_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Atreasure_troves_chain_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在星系中世世代代的海盗们把他们的不义之财藏在精心安放的宝库中。许多秘密宝藏都被遗弃或被认为已经丢失，但现在它们是我们的囊中之物了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1571`

### English

Throughout this galaxy's history, pirates have hidden their ill-gotten gains in carefully placed Treasure Troves. Many of those secret caches were abandoned and considered lost, but now they are ours for the taking.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1856`

## grand_archive.6010.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.6010.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们在[event_target:treasure_trove_planet.GetName]内探测到了一个微弱的信号。基于初步的破译结果，我们相信这是某个失踪已久的海盗§Y$TREASURE_TROVE$§!。\n\n尽管要费很多功夫，但相信我们能够发掘出其中的秘密。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1574`

### English

We have detected a faint signal from somewhere on [event_target:treasure_trove_planet.GetName]. Based on the rudimentary cryptography, we believe this to be from a long-lost pirate's §Y$TREASURE_TROVE$§!.\n\nIt will take some effort, but we're confident we would be able to unearth its secrets.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1861`

## grand_archive.6015.desc.specimen

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.6015.desc.specimen&lang=en)

### 中文

$grand_archive.6015.common.1$我们在一个密封容器内发现了一件远古海盗文物。这段海盗史将加入我们的收藏。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1579`

### English

$grand_archive.6015.common.1$, we have discovered an ancient pirate artifact preserved in a sealed container. This piece of buccaneer history will be added to our collection.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1867`

## grand_archive.6015.desc.specimen_extra

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.6015.desc.specimen_extra&lang=en)

### 中文

此外，我们还在巨大的§Y$TREASURE_TROVE$§!内发现一件远古海盗文物。通过小心的复原，这段海盗史将加入我们的收藏。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1580`

### English

Additionally, we have discovered an ancient pirate artifact hidden within the vast §Y$TREASURE_TROVE$§!. With careful restoration, this piece of buccaneer history will make a wonderful addition to our collection.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1868`

## grand_archive.6015.desc.pirate_ship

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.6015.desc.pirate_ship&lang=en)

### 中文

在小心地破解了遗失的§Y$TREASURE_TROVE$§!之后，我们发现了通往下方星球上一个点的模糊方向。我们在那里又发现了一艘由反探测阵列保护的令人难以置信的海盗战舰。\n\n该舰船名为[treasure_trove_pirate_ship.GetName]，现已加入加入我们的军队。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1581`

### English

After carefully disarming the lost §Y$TREASURE_TROVE$§!, we discovered analogue directions leading to a point on the planet below. There we found an incredible pirate battleship protected by an anti-detection array.\n\nThis ship, named [treasure_trove_pirate_ship.GetName], has been claimed for our military.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1869`

## grand_archive.6025.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.6025.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们在[from.GetName]搜寻§Y$TREASURE_TROVE$§!的过程中，[fromfromfrom.Leader.GetName][fromfromfrom.Leader.GetWasWere]遭到了一支海盗舰队的伏击！\n\n这些法外狂徒不知怎么发现了我们的进展，打算把这些宝物据为己有。如果我们想要拿到这些宝藏，就必须在他们抢到之前打败他们的舰队。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1609`

### English

As we were searching for the §Y$TREASURE_TROVE$§! on [from.GetName], [fromfromfrom.Leader.GetName] [fromfromfrom.Leader.GetWasWere] ambushed by a pirate fleet!\n\nThese outlaws have somehow trailed our progress and seek to take the treasure for themselves. If we are to collect this bounty, we must defeat their fleet before they secure the valuables.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1900`

## civic_beastmasters_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acivic_beastmasters_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在一个为太空变形虫提供食物的星系中诞生，这个社会已经达到了完全的技术成熟，对这些生物的生命周期有着深刻的了解。他们现在致力于繁育、培养并最终克隆这些生物，以实现互惠互利。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1657`

### English

Coming to full, technological maturity in a system that serves as a feeding ground for Space Amoebas, this society has acquired a deep knowledge of their life cycle. They now work to nurture, raise, and ultimately clone these creatures for mutual benefit.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1956`

### 中文

该机械智能直接与它们的母星系中的太空有机体交互，从而将这些强大的生物整合到它的核心功能中，产生一种互利的关系。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1659`

### English

Having interfaced directly with voidborne biological organisms in their home system, this Machine Intelligence has integrated these powerful creatures into its core functioning. A mutually beneficial relationship is the result.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:1958`

### 中文

这个蜂巢思维是一个拥有高度适应力的群体，他们已经演化出了与母星系中的太空生物有机体之间的共生关系。尽管思想不同，但他们会一起努力实现共同的目标。

## treasure_hunters_origin_story_chain_desc

我们发现了一张神秘的星图，于是决定踏上最伟大的冒险之旅。谁知道§H$celestial_chart$§!的尽头隐藏着什么，以及我们在旅途中会遇到什么危险。

After discovering a mysterious map to the stars, we embarked on our greatest adventure. Who knows what lies at the end of the §H$celestial_chart$§!, and what dangers we may face on our journey.

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Asmeegibb_shelter_system_2_poi_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们无法重新与$NAME_Smeegibb$建立通讯。由于这是我们获得§H$celestial_chart$§!下一部分的唯一线索，我们应该返回[smeegibb_system.GetName]调查情况。目前尚不清楚通讯突然中断的原因。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1822`

### English

We were unable to re-establish communications with $NAME_Smeegibb$. As our only clue to the next piece of the §H$celestial_chart$§!, we should return to [smeegibb_system.GetName] to investigate the situation. The reason behind the sudden break in contact is currently unknown.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2144`

### 中文

§Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§!再次追杀我们，杀死了我们的联络人$NAME_Smeegibb$并封锁了[from.GetName]星系。我们相信，§H$celestial_chart$§!的第四块碎片藏在[smeegibb_shelter.GetName]地表的某个地方。\n\n我们必须击败敌方舰队才能继续搜索。

We believe that the fourth piece of the §H$celestial_chart$§! is hidden somewhere on the surface of [smeegibb_shelter.GetName].\n\nWe must defeat the enemy fleet in order to search for the capsule.

我们对[this.GetHomeWorldName]发现的远古胶囊有了新的发现。得益于我们[this.GetScientistPlural]孜孜不倦的工作，现在将要完成解密数字密保的最后一层，破译令我们着迷已久的图表。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1857`

### English

We have made a breakthrough regarding the Ancient Capsule found orbiting [this.GetHomeWorldName]. Thanks to the tireless efforts of our [this.GetScientistPlural], we are now in a position to decrypt the final layer of digital security and decipher the chart that has intrigued us for so long.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2183`

## TREASURE_HUNTERS_ANCIENT_CAPSULE_PROJECT_DESC

### 中文

我们对轨道胶囊内包含的海图进行了初步分析，发现许多天体的位置并不在我们母星系内。还需要一些时间才能提取准确的坐标。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1860`

### English

Our initial analysis of the chart inside of the orbital capsule revealed the location of several celestial bodies not present in our home system. It will take time to extract the exact coordinates.

### English

## grand_archive.8005.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8005.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这张海图并不完整！\n\n轨道胶囊内的数据支离破碎，每一个明显的缺口都像是拼图中缺失的一块。尽管如此，它还是揭示了一个以前未知的恒星系坐标，然而关于在那里等待着我们的是什么并没有提供任何细节。\n\n该海图还突出了一系列用来进行超空间航行到达该目的地的突破点。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1862`

### English

The chart is only partially complete!\n\nThe data within the orbital capsule is fragmented, each conspicuous gap like the missing piece of a puzzle. Nevertheless, it reveals the coordinates of a previously-unknown star system, but does not provide any detail as to what awaits us there.\n\nThe chart also highlights a series of established breach points to facilitate hyperlane travel to the destination.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2190`

## grand_archive.8015.desc.common

### 中文

我们的舰队蓄势待发，准备踏上我们文明的下一段征途。

### English

## grand_archive.8015.desc.default

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8015.desc.default&lang=en)

### 中文

[this.GetHomeWorldName]的人口沉迷于最近解密的星图。人们叫它《§Y$celestial_chart$§!》，它目前带来的更多是疑问而非答案。它从何而来？是由谁出于什么目的撰写？而且或许最重要的是——这会把我们带向陷阱吗？\n\n$grand_archive.8015.desc.common$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1866`

### English

The population of [this.GetHomeWorldName] is enthralled with the recently deciphered star chart. Commonly referred to as the "§Y$celestial_chart$§!", so far it provides more questions than answers. Where did it come from? Who created it, and for what purpose? And perhaps most importantly - will it lead us into a trap?\n\n$grand_archive.8015.desc.common$

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2195`

## grand_archive.8015.desc.gestalt

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8015.desc.gestalt&lang=en)

### 中文

在胶囊里发现的星图吸引了全社会的注意。现在证明这不过是整张星图的冰山一角，不知道它将会把我们带向何处、找到什么。我们决定要完成这份《§Y$celestial_chart$§!》。\n\n$grand_archive.8015.desc.common$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1867`

### English

The discovery of the chart inside of the capsule has captured the attention of our society. Now that it has been revealed to be a piece among many, we wonder where it may lead and what we might find there. We are determined to complete this "§Y$celestial_chart$§!".\n\n$grand_archive.8015.desc.common$

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2196`

意外遭遇

### English

An Unexpected Encounter

## grand_archive.8020.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8020.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们遇到了一支悬挂不明旗帜的、全副武装的舰队。他们的船只列阵整齐，但设计五花八门。许多都配备了动能发射器，连接着挂碳钢钩和鱼叉的粗缆线。此外，在舰队中央还有一组装甲输送车。我们只能猜测这些船只是由一群海盗或雇佣兵控制的。\n\n我们收到了他们领头船发来的信号。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1871`

### English

We have encountered a heavily-armed fleet flying under an unknown flag. Their ships are in organized formation but not uniform in their design. Many are outfitted with kinetic launchers attached to reels of thick cable tipped with carbon steel hooks and harpoons. Additionally, there is a group of armored haulers sheltered in the center of the fleet. We can only surmise that these ships are controlled by a group of pirates or mercenaries.\n\nWe are receiving a transmission from their lead ship.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2201`

## grand_archive.8020.a.lom

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8020.a.lom&lang=en)

### 中文

那就谈谈吧……

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1872`

### English

A parley, then...

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2202`

## grand_archive.8025.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8025.name&lang=en)

### 中文

$NAME_BlackNeedle$的$NAME_CaptainHoo$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1873`

### English

$NAME_CaptainHoo$ of the $NAME_BlackNeedle$

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2204`

## grand_archive.8025.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8025.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H这位不法之徒的首领高傲而冷淡，装出一副漫不经心的样子。他说话时低头看着自己的喙，拒绝与我们对视，仿佛我们不值得他全神贯注。他用羽毛做着无意间滑稽的动作。§!\n\n你已经冒犯了§Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§!，你惹上麻烦了！\n\n我们听说你这新兴的小社会将探索这个恒星系。你偶然发现了一张明显属于我们的星图。交出来，否则别怪我们不客气。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1874`

### English

§HDistinguished and haughty, this outlaw captain feigns disinterest. He looks down his beak when speaking and refuses to meet our gaze, as if we are unworthy of his full attention. He gesticulates with his feathers in an inadvertently comical manner.§!\n\nYou have crossed the path of the §Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§!, a blunder on your part!\n\nWe caught wind of a rumor that your burgeoning little society would be exploring this system. You have stumbled upon a chart that clearly belongs to us. Hand it over, lest things become violent.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2205`

## grand_archive.8025.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8025.a&lang=en)

### 中文

你是何人？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1875`

### English

Who are you?

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2206`

## grand_archive.8025.a.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8025.a.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

我正是荷仁！我的全名是格里马荷·泽门德仁，但你也可以叫我§Y$NAME_CaptainHoo$§!，正是白银之风的船长，也是伟大的§Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§!海盗阁下手下的二副。几千年来，我们的羽翼已经深植各种法外买卖，而我不过是我们华丽挂毯上的一缕银丝。\n\n你最好记住我的名字，因为我希望在把这张图表交给我们无与伦比的领袖后能得到丰厚的赏金。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1876`

### English

Hoo I am! My name is Glimarhoo Zelmendrion, but you may refer to me as §Y$NAME_CaptainHoo$§!, Captain of the Silverwing and Second Mate Lieutenant of the illustrious §Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§! pirates. We have had our feathers in every variety of illicit dealings for thousands of years, and I am but one thread in the majestic tapestry of our legacy.\n\nYou would do well to remember my name, as I expect a significant bounty after presenting this chart to our peerless leader.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2207`

## grand_archive.8025.b

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8025.b&lang=en)

### 中文

关于这星图你们有什么头绪？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1877`

### English

What do you know of the chart?

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2208`

## grand_archive.8025.b.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8025.b.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

一位才华横溢、价格不菲的掮客告诉我们，你们最近偶然发现了一个奇特的胶囊……它里面应该有一个我们非常感兴趣的隐藏星系的位置。\n\n我们当然也拥有这星图的一部分，但如果不配上你们手上的那一份就毫无作用。真搞不懂为什么§Y$NAME_CaptainNess$§!要把她遗产的钥匙交给你们，但我们可有责任来帮你保管好它。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1878`

### English

A talented, and very expensive, information broker informed us that you recently stumbled upon a peculiar capsule... A capsule that is supposed to contain directions to a hidden system of great interest to us.\n\nWe ourselves have also claimed a piece of the chart, but it is useless without the data from your capsule. I cannot fathom why §Y$NAME_CaptainNess$§! would give you the key to her legacy, but it falls to us to relieve you of it.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2209`

## grand_archive.8025.c

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8025.c&lang=en)

### 中文

你们为什么这么想要这个星图？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1879`

### English

Why do you want this chart so badly?

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2210`

## grand_archive.8025.c.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8025.c.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

你是蠢还是怎么的？[this.GetCaptainHooSnarkyInsult]我大概是要一点一点掰碎了给你讲了。\n\n星图的作用是作为一种指向特定目的地的导航指引。我们想去那个地方，拿回遗失已久的§Y$NAME_CaptainNess$§!的宝藏。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1880`

### English

Are you really quite so naive? [this.GetCaptainHooSnarkyInsult] I guess I have to spell it out for you.\n\nA chart functions as a form of navigatory guidance towards a specific destination. We wish to visit that destination and claim the long-lost treasure of §Y$NAME_CaptainNess$§!.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2211`

## grand_archive.8025.d

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8025.d&lang=en)

### 中文

$NAME_CaptainNess$是谁？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1881`

### English

Who is $NAME_CaptainNess$?

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2212`

## grand_archive.8025.d.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8025.d.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

嗨，我还以为你们会更清楚呢。她就是这张星图的制作人。也许她发现你们的种族无知到可以托付吧，她就是那种会莫名恐惧的人。\n\n不过这终究不关你的事。把情报交出来，让我们带走它。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1882`

### English

We thought you would be better informed. She is the one who created this chart. Perhaps she found your species' ignorance to be relatable, the thoughtless terror that she was.\n\nUltimately, it is none of your concern. Hand over the information and we will take it from here.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2213`

## grand_archive.8025.e

We will be keeping our chart.

## grand_archive.8045.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8045.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

你侮辱我就罢了，你还侮辱§Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§!！这忍不了，一点也忍不了！\n\n你拒绝合作的态度我们会记着的。$NAME_BlackNeedle$会用一切手段来结训你。我们易怒之下就能把你那小小的初生文明给弄死。\n\n不交出那张星图我们是不会罢休的！今天就先放你们一马！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1903`

### English

You have made a mockery of myself and the §Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§!. This will not stand, not at all!\n\nYour unwillingness to cooperate will not soon be forgotten. The $NAME_BlackNeedle$ will come at you with all that we have. Your fledgling civilization will not survive our wrath.\n\nWe will not stop until that chart is ours! And now I shall bid you good day!

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2236`

## TREASURE_HUNTERS_CHART_PIECE_2_PROJECT_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ATREASURE_HUNTERS_CHART_PIECE_2_PROJECT_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

§H$celestial_chart$§!引导我们来到一个粉碎星球。我们探测到一条非自然形成的隧道深深钻入了行星最大地壳板块。相信星图的下一部分就隐藏在里面，但需要仔细挖掘才能获取。\n\n可以用工程船来建造必要的设备从而发掘出这块星图碎片。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1906`

### English

The §H$celestial_chart$§! has led us to a shattered world. We detected an unnatural tunnel drilled into the largest slab of planetary crust. We believe that the next piece of our chart is hidden within, but accessing it will require careful excavation.\n\nA construction ship would be able to build the necessary equipment to extract the piece.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2240`

## grand_archive.8055.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8055.name&lang=en)

### 中文

发掘成功

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1907`

### English

Excavation Successful

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2242`

## grand_archive.8055.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8055.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们从漂浮的行星碎片中提取出了一个胶囊和一些矿物。打开以后，我们发现了另一块§Y$celestial_chart$§!的碎片，以及一些独特的文物。此外，在里面发现了一张字条，为了便于翻译它还使用了多种语言撰写。\n\n“这里是$NAME_Soropegma$的最后废墟，乙特人母星。乙特人是一个前超光速物种，由于一场悲惨的事故而灭绝。我们没有意识到即将到来的后果，意外触发了被盗巨像的破坏力量。请保护和尊重他们的记忆。”

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1908`

### English

A capsule was successfully extracted from the drifting planetary debris alongside a quantity of minerals. Upon opening it, we discovered a new piece of the §Y$celestial_chart$§! and a selection of unique cultural artifacts. Additionally, a note was found inside, written in multiple languages to allow for easier translation.\n\n"This is all that remains of $NAME_Soropegma$, the Ytterite homeworld. The Ytterite were a Pre-FTL species rendered extinct as a result of a tragic accident. Unaware of the impending consequences, we accidentally triggered the destructive power of a stolen Colossus. Please preserve and respect their memory."

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2243`

## TREASURE_HUNTERS_ANCIENT_CAPSULE_2_PROJECT

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ATREASURE_HUNTERS_ANCIENT_CAPSULE_2_PROJECT&lang=en)

### 中文

解密星图碎片

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1909`

### English

Decipher the Chart Piece

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2245`

## TREASURE_HUNTERS_ANCIENT_CAPSULE_2_PROJECT_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ATREASURE_HUNTERS_ANCIENT_CAPSULE_2_PROJECT_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

从破碎行星的残骸中挖掘出胶囊后，我们需要破译其中的导航数据。这个过程需要交叉参照我们的制图数据库，并将标记的天体与已知星系进行比对。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1910`

### English

After excavating the capsule from the remains of the shattered planet, we need to decipher the navigation data within. This process will require cross-referencing our cartographic database and charting the marked celestial bodies against known systems.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2246`

## grand_archive.8060.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8060.name&lang=en)

### 中文

星图已解密

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1911`

### English

Chart Deciphered

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2248`

## grand_archive.8060.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8060.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

突破多层加密后，新数据被无缝地添加到§Y$celestial_chart$§!中。当所有碎片拼凑完成，一个全新的星系跃然眼前。我们旅程的下一步近在咫尺，应该谨慎地去探索这片未测绘的太空区域。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1912`

### English

After breaking multiple layers of encryption, the new data was added seamlessly to the §Y$celestial_chart$§!. Once the pieces were combined, yet another new system was revealed. The next step of our journey lies before us. We should approach this uncharted area of space with caution.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2249`

## grand_archive.8075.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8075.name&lang=en)

### 中文

博物天枢

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1913`

### English

A Grand Archive

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2251`

## grand_archive.8075.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8075.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

获得§Y[This.GetLastAcquiredSpecimenName]§!后，我们的科学家认为它应该在§Y$grand_archive$§!的公开展示区拥有一席之地。这座建筑将容纳我们不断壮大的珍稀文物收藏，这些文物将带来重大的文化和科学回报。我们将启动一项天使投资，用于保存和展示星系多样化和脆弱标本所需的技术的研发。\n\n此外，在乙特人文物旁还发现了一份蓝图，其中包含一种先进展示柜的设计，该展示柜配备了创新的气氛监测技术。进一步发展这个想法将增强档案的整体保存能力。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1914`

### English

Following the acquisition of the §Y[This.GetLastAcquiredSpecimenName]§!, our scientists believe that it deserves to be placed on public display in the context of a §Y$grand_archive$§!. This structure would house our budding collection of rare artifacts which will reap significant cultural and scientific returns. An early-stage investment would kickstart the research into the techniques and technologies required to preserve and display the galaxy's diverse and delicate specimens.\n\nAdditionally, a blueprint found alongside the Ytterite artifact was discovered containing an advanced design for a display case with innovative atmospheric monitoring technology. Developing this idea further would enhance the preservation capabilities of the archive in general.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2252`

## grand_archive.8076.name

### English

The Ytterite Specimen

## grand_archive.8076.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8076.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

失落的乙特文明的最后遗迹值得单独展出。\n\n幸运的是，在乙特文物旁边发现的一份蓝图包含一种先进展示柜的设计，该展示柜配备了创新的气氛监测技术。进一步发展这个想法将增强档案的整体保存能力。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1916`

### English

The final trace of the lost Ytterite civilization merits its own exhibition.\n\nFortunately, a blueprint found alongside the Ytterite artifact contains an advanced design for a display case with innovative atmospheric monitoring technology. Developing this idea further would enhance the preservation capabilities of the Archive in general.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2254`

### 中文

除了乙特人标本，我们还发现了一个用于保存标本的复杂展示柜的先进设计。\n\n研究该蓝图中使用的技术可能会帮助未来的保护和展览工作。

使用§Y工程船§!围绕一颗具有2.5K或以上£pop£§H人口§!的行星建造一座§Y博物天枢§!。\n需要：§H£society_research£$tech_galactic_archivism$§!。

## grand_archive.8080.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8080.name&lang=en)

展览强化

### English

Exhibition Enhancement

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2261`

## grand_archive.8080.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8080.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

经过对乙特蓝图的仔细分析，我们建造了一个先进的收纳单元，其大气监测精度可达原子级别。这将使策展员能够高度详细地监控珍贵乙特人标本的大气条件，并检测任何潜在腐烂的预警信号。它将永远保持原样。\n\n我们可以将这些技术应用于进一步改善我们收藏中所有物品的储存条件。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1922`

### English

After careful analysis of the Ytterite blueprint, we have constructed an advanced containment unit with precise atmospheric monitoring down to the atom. This would allow curators to monitor the atmospheric conditions of the delicate Ytterite specimen on a highly detailed level and detect any warning signs of potential decay. It will be just as it was, forever.\n\nWe can apply these techniques to further improve the storage conditions of every item in our collection.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2262`

## TREASURE_HUNTERS_BUILD_GRAND_ARCHIVE

在探索宇宙的过程中，我们收集了无数独特的文物和文化奇观。这些标本将激励民众，使我们的展览成为第一个展示和保护所有星系知识领域的展览。\n\n建造一个§H$grand_archive$§!正是为了这一目的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1924`

### English

Throughout our exploration of the cosmos, we have collected countless unique artifacts and cultural oddities. These specimens will inspire the populace and make our exhibition the first to showcase and conserve all fields of galactic knowledge.\n\nBuilding a §H$grand_archive$§! would suit this purpose.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2265`

Grand Archive Opening

## d_black_needle_base

### 中文

## grand_archive.8100.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8100.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们在[From.GetName]发现了一个带有§Y黑针§!标志的秘密地下基地。我们认为这是一个海盗集团的外部基地，与他们的其他行动隔离开来。§Y$celestial_chart$§!的下一部分一定存放在这里，很可能与其他财富和装饰品一起。\n\n我们可以轻松地对基地进行轨道轰炸，但这可能会给黑针足够的时间呼叫增援。另一方面，快速部署地面部队将更快地夺取基地，杀他们个措手不及。\n\n更隐秘的方法是入侵基地的计算机系统，直接大胆地抢走$celestial_chart$的那一部分。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1936`

### English

We have found a covert underground base on [From.GetName] bearing the insignia of the §YBlack Needle§!. We believe that this is an external base used by the piracy group, isolated from their other operations. The next piece of the §Y$celestial_chart$§! must be stored here, likely alongside other riches and baubles.\n\nWe could easily begin orbital bombardment of the base, but this may give the Black Needle the time they need to call for reinforcements. On the other hand, a rapid deployment of our ground forces would more swiftly seize the base, giving little time for the enemy to respond.\n\nA more clandestine approach would be to hack into the base's computer systems and secure the $celestial_chart$ piece in a daring heist.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2281`

## BLACK_NEEDLE_BASE_BOMBARD_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ABLACK_NEEDLE_BASE_BOMBARD_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

位于[This.GetName]的地下基地对轨道轰炸具有很强的抵抗力，但只要有足够的时间和火力，我们舰队就能将其摧毁。基地被摧毁后，我们可以搜寻废墟，以回收§H$celestial_chart$§!碎片和其他贵重物品。\n\n战术顾问提醒，这种做法可能会给黑针足够的时间呼叫增援。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1942`

### English

The underground base on [This.GetName] is highly resistant to orbital bombardment, but with enough time and firepower, it is possible to destroy it with our fleet alone. Once the base has been neutralized, we can search the ruins to recover the §H$celestial_chart$§! piece and any other valuables.\n\nTactical advisors caution that this approach may allow the Black Needle sufficient time to call for reinforcements.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2288`

## BLACK_NEEDLE_BASE_DEPLOY_ARMIES_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ABLACK_NEEDLE_BASE_DEPLOY_ARMIES_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

[FromFrom.GetName]地下基地受到大量军队和安保无人机的保护。在行星表面部署军队将使我们能够迅速占领基地，给§Y黑针§!几乎没有反应的机会。\n\n一旦我们控制了基地，就可以发掘星图胶囊以及海盗积累的任何其他不义之财。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1958`

### English

The underground base on [FromFrom.GetName] is protected by a significant number of troops and security drones. Deploying armies on the planet's surface would allow us to take over the base quickly, giving little opportunity for the §YBlack Needle§! to react.\n\nOnce we have secured the base, we can extract the chart capsule and any other ill-gotten goods the pirates have accumulated.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2308`

## BLACK_NEEDLE_BASE_HACK_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ABLACK_NEEDLE_BASE_HACK_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

海盗过度依赖偷窃和改装技术，这导致他们的基地容易受到渗透。可以让一艘科研船从轨道上入侵[FromFrom.GetName]的网络，伪装成§Y黑针§!运输船，并声称受荷仁船长的命令，说服他们移交星图胶囊，避免不必要的流血事件。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1964`

### English

The pirates' over-reliance on stolen and repurposed tech has left their base vulnerable to infiltration. A single research ship could hack the network on [FromFrom.GetName] from orbit, masquerading as a §YBlack Needle§! transport vessel under orders of Captain Hoo. This might convince them to transfer custody of the map capsule without needless bloodshed.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2316`

## grand_archive.8115.desc.1

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8115.desc.1&lang=en)

### 中文

经过数月的准备，科学家[Leader.GetName]成功潜入了通讯网络，并伪装成了一艘§Y黑针§!飞船。在伪造的荷仁船长命令下，[Leader.GetHeShe]欺骗了基地操作员，让他们准备将星图胶囊进行紧急星际转移。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1966`

### English

After months of preparation, Scientist [Leader.GetName] successfully infiltrated the communications network and impersonated a §YBlack Needle§! vessel. Under fabricated orders from Captain Hoo, [Leader.GetHeShe] [Leader.GetHasHave] tricked the base operators into preparing the capsule for emergency off-world transfer.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2319`

## grand_archive.8120.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8120.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

### English

The discovery led to a short firefight, as we were forced to flee the scene with the precious cargo in tow. The capsule was successfully extracted, but Scientist [Leader.GetName] [Leader.GetWasWere] killed in the crossfire.

## grand_archive.8130.desc.common

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8130.desc.common&lang=en)

### 中文

安全屋里存放着各种各样的贵重物品，以及与海盗组织历史相关的纪念品。我们在被盗的艺术品、个性化珠宝和加密的数字钱包中找到了星图胶囊。\n\n我们怀疑这里的大多数赃物根本难以销赃。艺术品一看便知，珠宝需要熔化成废料，使用数字钱包进行的交易通常也可以追踪。这些物品的原主人中，有些人可能已经去世，但其他人仍在寻找他们被盗的财产。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1983`

### English

The safe room contained a wide variety of valuable items as well as sentimental trinkets linked to the history of the pirate organization. We found the chart capsule among stolen artworks, personalized jewelry, and encrypted digital wallets.\n\nWe suspect that many of the goods discovered here would be difficult to sell. The artworks are recognizable, the jewelry would need to be melted down for scrap, and transactions using digital wallets are usually traceable. Some of the previous owners of these items could be long-dead, but others will still be looking for their stolen possessions.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2339`

## grand_archive.8130.desc.bombarded

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8130.desc.bombarded&lang=en)

### 中文

我们在§Y黑针§!基地的废墟中找到了一个地下金库，打开后发现里面藏着他们不义之财的小型宝藏。\n\n$grand_archive.8130.desc.common$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1984`

### English

Navigating the ruins of the §YBlack Needle§! base, we found an underground vault and opened it to reveal a small treasure trove of their ill-gotten gains.\n\n$grand_archive.8130.desc.common$

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2340`

## grand_archive.8130.desc.landed

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8130.desc.landed&lang=en)

### 中文

我们探索了破败的§Y黑针§!基地，发现了一份设施蓝图，揭露了还有一个地下金库的存在。我们乘坐维修电梯深入地下，输入了访问代码之后，发现了一个小型宝库，里面藏着他们不义之财。\n\n$grand_archive.8130.desc.common$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1985`

### English

Exploring the battered §YBlack Needle§! base, we found a blueprint of the facility that revealed the existence of an underground vault. Descending deep beneath the earth in a service elevator, we entered the access code to reveal a small treasure trove of their ill-gotten gains.\n\n$grand_archive.8130.desc.common$

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2341`

### 中文

### English

### English

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2354`

## grand_archive.8135.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8135.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们成功突破了数字加密层，并将新信息整合到§Y$celestial_chart$§!中。这又让我们发现了另一个值得探索的目的地，现在星图几乎完整了。我们相信只剩下最后一块拼图，并谨慎乐观地认为我们的探索即将结束。\n\n在解码导航数据的同时，我们也认为无瑕的舱体外壳值得分析。容器的强度和耐用性令人惊讶；复制这种材料的能力可以为未来的研究提供许多潜在的机会。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:1996`

### English

We successfully overcame the layers of digital encryption and integrated new information into the §Y$celestial_chart$§!. This revealed yet another destination to explore and now the chart is almost complete. We believe that there is only one piece of the puzzle remaining, and are cautiously optimistic that the end of our quest is in sight.\n\nWhile the navigational data was being decoded, the unblemished exterior of the capsule itself was deemed worthy of analysis. The strength and durability of the container was surprising; the ability to replicate this material could provide many potential opportunities for future research.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2355`

## grand_archive.8200.desc.common_1

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8200.desc.common_1&lang=en)

### 中文

我们在[FROM.GetName]发现了一个小型定居点，人口不到一千，居民是一些感性软体动物。对该物种的初步生物学分析表明，它们具有亚空间突触交流的能力，表明存在一个蜂巢思维。除了这个孤立的营地外，这颗星球上没有其他智慧生命。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2004`

### English

We have found a small settlement on [FROM.GetName] with a population of less than a thousand sentient molluscoids. Preliminary biological analysis of the species shows a capacity for subspace ephapse communication, indicating the existence of a hive mind. Other than this isolated encampment, the planet is uninhabited by any other sentient life.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2365`

## grand_archive.8205.a.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8205.a.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

斯马拉克！这个星球是我们的居住地，我们生活在远离星系暴力的安全之中。以前，我们曾参与过暴力。杀戮、犯罪、海盗行径——我们什么都干过。但现在不再如此，我们只照顾我们的水培农场。\n\n在当海盗之前，我们是难民，没有人愿意收留我们，除了§Y船长§!。她救助我们脱离了悲惨的命运，并允许我们加入她的船队。船长给了我们一个新名字，作为交换，我们负责照顾飞船。\n\n我们负责清洁、烹饪、弹药、水栽和货物管理。我们辛勤工作。然后我们加入了登船突击队。船长盗取宝藏或劫掠时保护她。绝不背叛船长。我们始终忠诚。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2013`

### English

Smarak! This planet is our quarters. We live twicesafe, far from a violent galaxy. Before now, we join violence. Killing, crime, piracy - we do it all. No more. We tend our hydroponics.\n\nBefore then, we are refugees. No one takes us in, until §YThe Captain§!. She saves us from a bad fate and allows us to join her crew. The Captain gives us a new name and in exchange we take care of ship.\n\nWe do cleaning, cooking, munitions, hydroponics and cargo. We work. Then we join boarding party. Protect The Captain when she steals treasure or does kidnapping. Never betray The Captain. Always we are loyal.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2375`

## grand_archive.8205.b

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8205.b&lang=en)

### 中文

你对§Y$celestial_chart$§!有何了解？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2014`

### English

What do you know about the §Y$celestial_chart$§!?

## grand_archive.8205.b.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8205.b.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

斯玛拉克！我们对什么导航图一无所知，我们只待在自己的房间里。如果§Y船长§!做了一张导航图把你带到这里，一定有她的理由……她想帮助我们，或者伤害我们。我们永远无法确定。船长很狡猾。\n\n她有时会给我们发消息。船长给我们送来了一座她最喜欢的子个体的巨型雕像，那是她救出过的$NAME_Smeegibb$并且一直记得。它很令人印象深刻，但我们不知道她为什么要送。也许她想道歉，但她没有留下任何纸条。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2015`

### English

Smarak! We know no chart, we only stay in our quarters. If §YThe Captain§! makes a chart to bring you here, there must be a reason why... She wants to help us, or harm us. We are never sure. The Captain can be tricky.\n\nShe messages us at one time. The Captain sends us a giant statue of her favorite drone, the $NAME_Smeegibb$ she remembers and she saves from before. It is impressive, but we know not why she sends. Maybe she wants to apologize, but she gives no note.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2377`

## grand_archive.8205.c

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8205.c&lang=en)

### 中文

和我们聊聊§Y船长§!的更多事情。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2016`

### English

Tell us more about §YThe Captain§!.
