## grand_archive.8205.c.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8205.c.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

斯玛拉克！以前，§Y船长§!拯救了我们。以前，她是我们的导师和领袖。她教我们如何照顾飞船。她说：“$NAME_Smeegibb$，做军需官、机械师和劳工——你很有价值。”\n\n船长遵循两条信条：“财富即独立”和“生命在于传承”。我们一起猎杀穷人和富人。我们从暴力的星系中夺取我们想要的东西。\n\n但后来船长变得愈发贪婪和鲁莽。她牺牲船员，或者为了赏金背叛他们。船长失去了所有人，除了$NAME_Smeegibb$。我们始终忠诚。\n\n她让我们看到了星系的暴力。现在我们只想远离它。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2017`

### English

Smarak! Before now, §YThe Captain§! saves us. Before she is our mentor and leader. She teaches us to take care of ship. She says "$NAME_Smeegibb$, work as quartermaster, mechanic, and labor - you are excellent value."\n\nThe Captain lives by two creeds: "Wealth is independence" and "Life exists for legacy". Together we hunt the poor and rich. We take what we want from violent galaxy.\n\nBut then The Captain is twicegreedy and twicereckless. She sacrifices crewmates or betrays them for bounty. The Captain loses everyone but $NAME_Smeegibb$. Always we are loyal.\n\nShe shows us how violent galaxy is. Now we prefer to stay away.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2379`

Investigating this location may lead us to the next piece of the §Y$celestial_chart$§!, or at least a clue to guide us in the right direction.

### 中文

在[fromfrom.planet.GetName]的冰冷荒原上，我们发现了一个小型预制庇护所，里面配备了休眠的生命维持系统和生活区。它们经过数千年的冰暴，严重风化，部分被掩埋。

## grand_archive.8220.name

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2029`

### English

Captain's Log

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2396`

## grand_archive.8220.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8220.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

挖掘出的建筑显示出长期使用的迹象。它曾经拥有充足的基本设施。在整个建筑中发现了零散的饰品和奇珍异宝。在一堆凌乱的纸张中，我们找到了由§Y$NAME_CaptainNess$§!本人写下的日志条目。\n\n§L我们登上并劫持了另一艘佩里坎的珍宝运输船，但这次他们已经做好了准备。附带损失比我想象的要多一些，但我们解决过更糟糕的情况。不错的收益，但塔皮科宝石仍然在逃。不幸的是，现在佩里坎人又提高了赏金，联邦也介入了。现在情况有点棘手。可能需要避一避风头。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2030`

### English

The excavated structure showed evidence of long periods of use. It was once well-stocked with basic amenities. Trinkets and curios have been discovered strewn throughout the building. Within a pile of messy papers, we recovered a log entry written by §Y$NAME_CaptainNess$§! herself.\n\n§LWe boarded and hijacked another Perikan treasury transport, but this time they were ready for us. More collateral than I'd like, but we've handled worse. Decent payout, but the Tapico Jewel continues to elude us. Unfortunately, now the Perikans have increased their bounty again and the Federation has gotten involved. Things are a bit hot right now. Might need to lay low for a while.§!

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2397`

## grand_archive.8225.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8225.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在结构下方的挖掘发现了一小批贵重物品和基本的卫生系统。不幸的是，在彻底搜查了该区域后，我们未能找到任何关于§Y$celestial_chart$§!碎片的痕迹。\n\n我们收集了更多笔记本和文件，希望能从§Y$NAME_CaptainNess$§!散乱的日志条目中找到线索。\n\n§L在像$NAME_Smeegibb$这样的伙伴陪伴下时间过得没那么慢，但值得分享荣耀吗？当然，与一个蜂巢思维合作有难以置信的价值。用仅仅一份利润的份额换取数百个子个体的使用权？真是个好交易！但也许他们所做的工作会削弱我自己的成就……？我不确定我是否能接受分享自己遗产的想法。我需要再仔细考虑一下。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2033`

### English

Digging beneath the structure revealed a small stash of valuables and basic sanitation systems. Unfortunately, after scouring the area completely, we were unable to find any evidence of a piece of the §Y$celestial_chart$§!.\n\nWe have collected more notebooks and papers in the hope of discovering a clue within §Y$NAME_CaptainNess$§!'s scattered log entries.\n\n§LTime passes less slowly with a partner like $NAME_Smeegibb$, but is it worth splitting the glory? Sure, working with a hive mind has incredible value. Access to hundreds of drones in exchange for just a single cut of the profits? What a deal! But maybe the work they do takes away from my own achievements...? I'm not sure I can live with the idea of sharing my legacy. I'll need to give this more thought.§!

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2401`

## grand_archive.8230.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8230.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在一个通风口里，我们发现了§Y$NAME_CaptainNess$§!的最后日记。\n\n§L我不想以这种方式被记住。$NAME_Smeegibb$一直是我的忠实伙伴，但不要说我需要他们。我可以独自征服星系。我会留下我的印记，荣耀将属于我。还有财富。\n\n给自己留个笔记：最好给$NAME_Smeegibb$送点东西留作纪念。§!\n\n这就是我们能找到的全部。没有关于船长或§Y$celestial_chart$§!的任何其他线索。\n\n也许给$NAME_Smeegibb$的礼物中包含着关于最后一块碎片下落的线索。我们必须重新与他们建立联系。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2036`

### English

Concealed within an air vent, we discovered §Y$NAME_CaptainNess$§!' final journal entry.\n\n§LThis isn't how I want to be remembered. $NAME_Smeegibb$ has been a loyal companion, but never let it be said I needed them. I can take on the galaxy solo. I'll leave MY mark, and the glory will be mine. As well as the riches.\n\nNote to self: Better send $NAME_Smeegibb$ something to remember me by.§!\n\nThis is all there is left to find. There is no other trace of the Captain or any sign of the §Y$celestial_chart$§!.\n\nPerhaps the gift to $NAME_Smeegibb$ that was mentioned holds some clue to the whereabouts of the final piece. We must re-open communications with them.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2405`

## grand_archive.8241.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8241.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一支印着名为§Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§!的海盗组织的旗帜的庞大舰队，被发现正在[smeegibb_shelter.GetName]轨道上运行。我们相信这些海盗一直在跟踪我们的行动，并且已经夷平了名为$NAME_Smeegibb$的集体的居所。他们一定还在寻找§Y$celestial_chart$§!的下一部分。\n\n该星球上没有发现任何智慧生命迹象。\n\n我们正在接收来自他们旗舰的信号。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2043`

### English

A sizable fleet bearing the flag of the pirate organization known as the §Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§! has been sighted orbiting [smeegibb_shelter.GetName]. We believe that these pirates have been shadowing our movements, and have razed the settlement housing the collective known as $NAME_Smeegibb$. They must still be searching for the next piece of the §Y$celestial_chart$§!.\n\nNo signs of sentient life remain on the planet.\n\nWe are receiving a transmission from their lead ship.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2414`

How did you softshells manage to defeat §YK-k-kaptain Hoo§!? Even that old k-k-kretin should have easily eliminated your pitiful fleet. You will pay for

### 中文

难道你不知道自己拥有了什么吗？这是通往§Y船—船—船长奈斯§!宝藏的路线图！她一生中积攒的每一块—块—块珠宝都在这里。\n\n这些财富属于我们。一旦我们拥有它，我们就能名留青史。每一个恒星系都将畏惧§Y黑—黑—黑针§!……而这史诗的第一篇章将属于你。难道我们还不够慷慨吗？

Once we have it, we will sing our names into history. Every system will come to fear the §YBlack-k-k Needle§!... And the first note in the k-k-korus will be yours. Are we not generous?

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ATREASURE_HUNTERS_CHART_PIECE_3_PROJECT_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

根据我们的调查，我们认为§H$celestial_chart$§!的下一部分隐藏在[this.GetName]的早已沦为废墟的定居点中。\n\n鉴于其他胶囊的结构十分坚固，我们可以假设它在最近的轰炸中留存下来。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2069`

### English

Based on our investigation, we believe that the next piece of the §H$celestial_chart$§! is hidden somewhere within the ruined settlement on [this.GetName].\n\nGiven the sturdy construction of the other capsules, we can assume that it has survived the recent bombardment.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2445`

## grand_archive.8270.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8270.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们在[from.GetName]寻找§Y$celestial_chart$§!第四块碎片的行动已圆满结束。我们在一座石雕上发现了嵌入其中的胶囊，雕像描绘的是一个来自现已灭绝的$NAME_Smeegibb$集体组织的子个体。雕像上的铭文如下：\n\n§L“献给我的忠诚船员：这是我对你的感谢。愿你的孤独长久而平静。”§!\n\n一旦这最后一块碎片被破译，我们就可以继续寻找§Y$NAME_CaptainNess$§!的宝藏。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2071`

### English

Our search for the fourth piece of the §Y$celestial_chart$§! on [from.GetName] has concluded successfully. The capsule was found embedded within a stone statue of a drone from the now-extinct collective known as $NAME_Smeegibb$. The inscription on the statue reads as follows:\n\n§L"To my loyal crewmate: a token of my appreciation. May your solitude be long and peaceful."§!\n\nOnce this final piece of the chart is decoded, we can continue our search for §Y$NAME_CaptainNess$§!' treasure.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2448`

## TREASURE_HUNTERS_ANCIENT_CAPSULE_4_PROJECT_DESC

### 中文

从$NAME_Smeegibb$定居点废墟中发掘出胶囊后，剩下的就是解密里面的数据，并完成§H$celestial_chart$§!。我们很快就会发现§H$NAME_CaptainNess$§!的踪迹尽头等待着我们的是什么。

After extracting the capsule from the ruins of $NAME_Smeegibb$'s settlement, all that remains is to decrypt the data inside and complete the §H$celestial_chart$§!. We will soon discover what awaits us at the end of §H$NAME_CaptainNess$§!' trail.

## grand_archive.8280.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8280.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

解码后，新的数据片段完成了我们的§Y$celestial_chart$§!。各个节点上闪烁着光点，指示着我们沿途发现的中间目的地。然后，四盏灯同时闪烁，揭示了另一个隐藏的恒星系。\n\n添加最后一块数据解锁了额外的功能。这份§Y导航图§!不仅仅是一张简单的地图，它包含了§Y$NAME_CaptainNess$§!收集的关于星系中失落财富和非法珍宝的信息。一些数据可能已经过期，但该设备可以有效地检测到我们所有恒星系中隐藏的宝藏。\n\n此外，§Y星图§!还包含了船长在其职业生涯中发现的每件珍宝的评估信息。这些详细的笔记解释了如何识别、评估和向潜在买家展示获得的贵重物品，以获得最大利润。重新激活设备将提供独特宝藏库的设计，使我们的殖民地能够利用船长的无与伦比的洞察力，为我们的宝藏增值。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2075`

### English

Once decoded, the new data fragment completed our §Y$celestial_chart$§!. Points of light shone at various nodes indicating the interim destinations we have discovered along the way. The four lights then flickered in unison before revealing another hidden system.\n\nAdding the final piece of the data has unlocked additional capabilities. The §YChart§! is not a simple map, it contains information on lost riches and illicit treasure troves across the galaxy as collected by §Y$NAME_CaptainNess$§!. Some of the data may have expired, but this device can feasibly detect hidden caches of valuable treasure across all of our systems.\n\nFurthermore, the §YChart§! contains appraisal information on every treasure the Captain discovered throughout her career. These detailed notes explain how to identify, appraise, and present acquired valuables to potential sellers for maximum profit. Reactivating the device will provide designs for a unique Treasure Vault allowing our colonies to take advantage of the Captain's unparalleled insight and add value to our hoard.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2454`

## grand_archive.8285.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8285.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§Y$celestial_chart$§!的完成对于[this.GetName]来说是一个重大的时刻。随着所有秘密的解开，我们被指引到一个无从回避的目的地：[gateway_to_ness_treasure_system.GetName]星系。\n\n在克服了许多障碍之后，我们只差一步之遥。只有一个问题仍然存在：§Y星图§!的尽头是什么？\n\n我们无法保证一定可以马到成功，但我们也决不容许其他人趁机夺取。让我们奋勇前进，完成这场冒险！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2078`

### English

The completion of the §Y$celestial_chart$§! is a momentous occasion for [this.GetName]. With all its secrets unlocked, we are pointed to one inescapable destination: the [gateway_to_ness_treasure_system.GetName] system.\n\nAfter overcoming many obstacles, we are but one step away. Only one question remains: what lies at the end of the §YChart§!?\n\nThere is no guarantee of success, but we would not have it any other way. Let us strike forth to see this adventure through!

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2458`

## grand_archive.8300.desc.did_encounter_voidworms

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8300.desc.did_encounter_voidworms&lang=en)

### 中文

地图将我们带到一个以前未探明的黑洞，以及一个被$NAME_Voidworms$寄生的恒星系。它们在附近一座废弃的星门安家，其中最大的几只像守护者一样绕着这处废弃的建筑盘旋。\n\n$grand_archive.8300.desc.common$如果我们要到达路线的终点，必须消灭$NAME_Voidworms$并修复星门。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2101`

### English

The map has led us to a previously uncharted black hole, and a system infested with $NAME_Voidworms$. Having taken up nest in a derelict Gateway nearby, the largest of them circle the abandoned structure possessively.\n\n$grand_archive.8300.desc.common$ If we are to reach the trail's end, we must eliminate the $NAME_Voidworms$ and repair the Gate.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2485`

## grand_archive.8300.desc.didnt_encounter_voidworms

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8300.desc.didnt_encounter_voidworms&lang=en)

### 中文

地图将我们带到一个以前未探明到的黑洞，以及一个充满奇怪生物的恒星系。这些生物聚集在一个废弃星门的附近，其中最大的生物绕着这个废弃的结构盘旋，仿佛占领了此处。\n\n这些巨大的虫状生物不在我们关于太空兽群的数据库中。我们目前正在尝试建立通信。$grand_archive.8300.desc.common$如果我们要到达轨迹的尽头，我们必须处理这些生物并修复星门。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2102`

### English

The map has led us to a previously uncharted black hole, and a system infested with strange creatures. Having gathered around a derelict Gateway nearby, the largest of them circle the abandoned structure possessively.\n\nThese massive worm-like entities are not present in our databases of spaceborne fauna. We are currently attempting to establish communications. $grand_archive.8300.desc.common$ If we are to reach the trail's end, we must deal with these creatures and repair the Gate.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2486`

### 中文

[this.solar_system.GetName]星系中虚空虫的尸骸显示出异常读数。我们的扫描仪似乎在一个垂垂死去的三头虫中探测到生命迹象。我们应该派遣一艘科研船去进一步调查。

## grand_archive.8310.desc.did_encounter_voidworms

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8310.desc.did_encounter_voidworms&lang=en)

### 中文

在一具虚空虫的尸体中，发现了一群刚刚孵化的若虫。尽管它们的同类遭受了屠戮，但它们还是靠近了我们的飞船，并开始与我们的舰队并肩漂浮，以示恳求。\n\n$grand_archive.8310.desc.common$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2112`

### English

A clutch of nymphs were found nestled within one of the Voidworm carcasses. Despite the losses inflicted to their kin, they approached our vessels and began to drift alongside our fleet in supplication.\n\n$grand_archive.8310.desc.common$

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2499`

## grand_archive.8310.desc.didnt_encounter_voidworms

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2113`

### English

A clutch of younglings were found nestled within one of the serpentine carcasses. Despite the losses inflicted to their kin, they approached our vessels and began to drift alongside our fleet in supplication.\n\n$grand_archive.8310.desc.common$

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2500`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aness_treasure_system_poi_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们沿着§H$celestial_chart$§!指引的路线走到了尽头，一路击退了海盗和怪兽。现在，通往彼岸的通道已经开启，剩下的就是去探索星门那一头了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2139`

### English

We have followed the §H$celestial_chart$§! to its end, fending off pirates and monstrous creatures. The Gateway is now active, all that remains is to discover what lies on the other side.

## grand_archive.8405.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8405.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们被跟踪了。\n\n现在，我们在[ness_treasure_system.GetName]遭遇了一支强大的§Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§!舰队。与我们上次遭遇相比，他们的队伍规模显著扩大，包括退役的军舰和改装了高级武器的民用船只。看来他们已经集结了大部分预备舰队来应对这次对抗。舰队中央是他们的旗舰，一艘巨大的$titan$级战舰。\n\n虽然他们的编队已做好战斗准备，但大多数舰船尚未启动武器。看来他们打算谈判。\n\n我们正在接收来自旗舰的通讯。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2150`

### English

We were followed.\n\nWe are now confronted by an imposing §Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§! fleet in [ness_treasure_system.GetName]. In comparison to our last encounter, their ranks have swelled significantly to include decommissioned military ships and civilian vessels retrofitted with high-grade armaments. It appears that they have assembled the bulk of their reserve fleets for this confrontation. At the center of the fleet lies their flagship, a massive $titan$ class vessel.\n\nWhile their formation is battle-ready, most ships have not yet primed their weapons. It seems they intend to negotiate.\n\nWe are receiving a transmission from the flagship.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2548`

### English

## grand_archive.8410.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8410.name&lang=en)

### 中文

$NAME_CobaltQuill$，$NAME_BlackNeedle$的舰长

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2152`

### English

$NAME_CobaltQuill$, Captain of the $NAME_BlackNeedle$

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2551`

## grand_archive.8410.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8410.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H尽管身材矮小，这位海盗船长却散发着威严。他的眼睛在盘算着，仿佛在解一道复杂的方程式，将我们仔细评估。§!\n\n终于见面了。$NAME_CobaltQuill$，§Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§!号船长，我们家族的荣耀，也是$NAME_SilverQuill$创始人的后裔，向您致敬！您多年来一直是我们的一根刺——但我还是讲道理的。我带着一个提议而来。\n\n我们会为您的完整星图支付丰厚的赏金，并允许您带着你们无足轻重的性命离开。\n\n如果您拒绝，我们将别无选择，只能强行夺取我们想要的东西。我们的海军实力占优，并且我们也渗透了您帝国的所有关键设施。只要我一声令下，您就会彻底崩溃。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2153`

### English

§HDespite his small stature, this pirate captain emanates gravitas. His eyes are calculating, weighing us up as if part of a complex equation.§!\n\nAt last we finally meet. $NAME_CobaltQuill$ at your service; Captain of the illustrious §Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§! and humble descendant of our founder, $NAME_SilverQuill$. You have been a thorn in my side for a great many years - but I'm reasonable if nothing else. I come to you with an offer.\n\nWe will give you a significant bounty for your completed chart and allow you to leave with your meaningless lives intact.\n\nIf you refuse, we will have no choice but to take what we want by force. Our naval superiority notwithstanding, we have also infiltrated every place you hold dear. A single command of mine is all that keeps you from total ruin.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2552`

## grand_archive.8410.a

## grand_archive.8410.a.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8410.a.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

尽管你造成了诸多困扰，但我愿意提供丰厚的赏金，以换取§Y$NAME_CaptainNess$§!完整的遗物。\n\n如果你接受这份慷慨的提议，我准备原谅你过去的所有过失。我们之间没有必要继续这场冲突。或者升级……

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2155`

### English

Despite the frustrations you have caused, I am willing to provide a significant bounty in exchange for §Y$NAME_CaptainNess$§!'s completed relic.\n\nIf you accept this generous offer, I am prepared to forgive all past misdeeds. There is no need for this conflict between us to continue. Or escalate...

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2554`

## grand_archive.8410.b.reply.common_1

### 中文

关于[this.GetName]，我无所不知。你的供应链、资源库的位置、空间站的分布，一切都记录得清清楚楚。

## grand_archive.8410.b.reply.common_2

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8410.b.reply.common_2&lang=en)

### 中文

我的人已经进行了研究，我完全清楚如何瓦解你的帝国。我会让你的人民陷入饥荒，偷走你的补给，并摧毁剩余的一切。当然，这取决于你是否愿意给我想要的东西……

### English

My people have done the research, and I know exactly how to take you apart. I will starve your people, steal your supplies, and destroy whatever remains. That is, of course, unless you give me what I want...

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2557`

## grand_archive.8410.c

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8410.c&lang=en)

### 中文

何必多此一举和我们谈判？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2162`

### English

Why bother negotiating?

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2561`

## grand_archive.8410.c.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8410.c.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

这种规模的破坏行动可不便宜。船舶维护、工资、贿赂，这些东西都很昂贵，大手大脚花钱可不会带来暴富。等待你们的毁灭规模巨大，按下开关就能实现，这其中有很大的机会成本。\n\n有更好的地方可以花我的辛苦赚来的钱。来吧，让我们避免更多无谓的流血。拿着你们新获得的财富，离开这里，让专业人士来做海盗。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2163`

### English

A sabotage operation of this scale doesn't come cheap. Ship upkeep, wages, bribes; these things are expensive, and I didn't get rich by spending when I don't have to. There is a significant opportunity cost for the sheer scale of destruction that awaits you at the flip of a switch.\n\nThere are better ways to spend my hard-earned money. Come, let us avoid more meaningless bloodshed. Take your newfound wealth and leave the piracy to the experts.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2562`

## grand_archive.8410.d

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8410.d&lang=en)

### 中文

这不仅仅是钱的问题，对吧？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2164`

### English

This isn't just about the credits, is it?

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2563`

## grand_archive.8410.d.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8410.d.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

五千年前，我的祖先，伟大的$NAME_SilverQuill$，是$NAME_CaptainNess$的副手。他忠心耿耿地为她服务多年，可最终得到了什么回报？\n\n背叛！\n\n她将他交给了当局，并独吞了赏金！当然，没有任何监狱能够囚禁强大的$NAME_SilverQuill$。\n\n在一次大胆的逃脱后，他从灰烬中崛起，将他的杂牌军锻造成如今站在你面前的传奇$NAME_BlackNeedle$。他发誓要报复背叛他的$NAME_CaptainNess$，将毕生精力投入到掠夺她的宝藏，并用自己的成功掩埋她的名声。\n\n我只是在完成他的遗愿。这张星图是夺回我们应得之物的关键。\n\n现在，请把它交出来。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2165`

### English

5000 years ago my ancestor, the great $NAME_SilverQuill$, was the First Mate of $NAME_CaptainNess$. He gave her years of loyal service, and how was he repaid?\n\nBetrayal!\n\nShe handed him over to the authorities and pocketed the bounty! But of course, no prison could contain the mighty $NAME_SilverQuill$.\n\nAfter a daring escape, he rose from the proverbial ashes, forging his motley crew into the legendary $NAME_BlackNeedle$ that stands before you today. Swearing revenge against the traitorous $NAME_CaptainNess$, he dedicated his life to looting her treasure and burying her legacy under the weight of his own success.\n\nI am simply finishing what he started. This chart is the key to reclaiming what is rightfully ours.\n\nNow please, hand it over.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2564`

## grand_archive.8415.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8415.name&lang=en)

### 中文

大胆的提案

### English

A Bold Proposition

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2566`

## grand_archive.8415.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8415.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§!的首领提出了一项提议，他们愿意支付巨额赏金来换取§Y$celestial_chart$§!。如果我们接受了这个交易，就等于将§Y$NAME_CaptainNess$§!宝藏的关键拱手相让。\n\n拒绝他们的提议将会招致他们的怒火。这些海盗渗透到我们军队序列中的程度尚不清楚，但他们威胁要从内部彻底瓦解[this.GetName]。这些威胁是否只是虚张声势，还有待观察。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2167`

### English

The leader of the §Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§! has made a proposition, offering us a significant bounty in exchange for the §Y$celestial_chart$§!. If we took this deal, we would be handing over the key to §Y$NAME_CaptainNess$§!'s treasure.\n\nRejecting this proposal will invoke their full wrath. The extent to which these pirates have infiltrated our ranks is unknown, but they have threatened to completely dismantle [this.GetName] from the inside out. Whether these are but empty threats remains to be seen.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2567`

## grand_archive.8500.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8500.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们以一笔巨额$MONEY$和一艘名为§Y针眼§!的非凡军舰作为报酬，给出了§Y$celestial_chart$§!。我们可以认为我们与§Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§!的争端已彻底解决。\n\n我们避免了与他们全部舰队进行重大交战，并阻止了一次对星系规模的蓄意破坏企图。\n\n最好还是让海盗们继续做他们的海盗勾当。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2172`

### English

We handed over the §Y$celestial_chart$§! in exchange for a large sum of $MONEY$ and an exceptional military flagship known as §YThe Eye of the Needle§!. We can consider our dispute with the §Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§! to be settled once and for all.\n\nWe have avoided a significant engagement with the full force of their fleets and prevented a sabotage attempt on a galactic scale.\n\nBetter that we simply leave piracy to the pirates.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2573`

### English

## grand_archive.8505.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8505.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§!发起了全面攻击，给我们带来影响广泛的混乱。生产线停产，发电机烧毁，重要的行政基础设施被迫下线。货物消失，研究站的数据被清空，矿井坍塌速度是正常速度的五倍。\n\n这场全方位的破坏是数千名歹毒的参与者协同作案的结果。一个庞大的破坏者网络潜伏在我们之中，他们似乎总是领先我们一步。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2177`

### English

The §Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§! has launched an all-out assault, unleashing widespread chaos. Assembly lines have ground to a halt, generators have burnt out, and essential administrative infrastructure has been taken offline. Shipments are disappearing, research stations have had their data wiped, and mines are collapsing at five times the typical rate.\n\nThe devastation is total; the result of insidious handiwork of thousands of malevolent actors working in tandem. A vast network of saboteurs is hidden among us and they seem to be one step ahead of us.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2580`

## grand_archive.8520.desc.common

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8520.desc.common&lang=en)

### 中文

我们截获了§Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§!在我们殖民地使用的隐藏通信频率。在解密他们的信息后，我们已经能够识别出我们队伍中的所有叛徒和破坏分子。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2192`

### English

We have intercepted a hidden communications frequency used by the §Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§! throughout our colonies. After decrypting their messages, we have been able to identify every traitorous conspirator and saboteur within our ranks.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2597`

## grand_archive.8520.desc.machine

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8520.desc.machine&lang=en)

### 中文

$grand_archive.8520.desc.common$\n\n他们的特工一直秘密地在我们的操作系统中传播恶意软件，制造了一个由叛乱单位构成的休眠军队，潜伏在我们系统各个位置。\n\n这个歹毒的重新编程计划已经走得如此之远，以至于腐化了[root.GetName]中最重要的独立节点之一，§Y[traitor_leader.GetClass][traitor_leader.GetName]§!。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2193`

### English

$grand_archive.8520.desc.common$\n\nTheir operatives have been covertly spreading insidious malware within our operating systems, creating a sleeper army of rebel units occupying various positions across our systems.\n\nThe malicious reprogramming scheme has gone so far as to corrupt one of the most significant independent nodes in [root.GetName], §Y[traitor_leader.GetClass] [traitor_leader.GetName]§!.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2598`

## grand_archive.8520.desc.hive

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8520.desc.hive&lang=en)

### 中文

$grand_archive.8520.desc.common$\n\n他们的特工一直在居住地释放分离性信息素，导致我们许多工蜂产生了潜在的偏差。一旦被迷惑住，海盗们将我们的工蜂重新安置到休眠特工的舱室，他们目前正在破坏我们的基础设施。\n\n这个庞大的计划已经发展到腐蚀[root.GetName]中最重要的独立节点之一，§Y[traitor_leader.GetClass][traitor_leader.GetName]§!。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2194`

### English

$grand_archive.8520.desc.common$\n\nTheir operatives have been flooding habitats with dissociative pheromones, causing many of our drones to develop an underlying deviance. Once disillusioned, the pirates reorganized our drones into pods of sleeper agents who are currently tearing down our infrastructure.\n\nThe extensive scheme has gone so far as to corrupt one of the most significant independent nodes in [root.GetName], §Y[traitor_leader.GetClass] [traitor_leader.GetName]§!.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2599`

## grand_archive.8520.desc.default

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8520.desc.default&lang=en)

### 中文

$grand_archive.8520.desc.common$\n\n我们已经得知他们的特工多年来一直在招募心怀不满的公民，为这次大规模袭击做准备，他们利用潜伏的间谍网络和各种随时准备背叛我们的线人。\n\n其中一名叛徒已暴露，正是§Y[traitor_leader.GetClass][traitor_leader.GetName]§!，这构成了重大的安全风险。我们必须处理这个阴谋家，同时保持一定程度的稳定。公众得知这种程度的腐败将对我们的政府造成严重后果。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2195`

### English

$grand_archive.8520.desc.common$\n\nWe have learned their operatives have been recruiting disgruntled citizens for years, preparing for this extensive attack with sleeper cells and a variety of assets ready to turn against us.\n\nOne of the traitors has been revealed to be §Y[traitor_leader.GetClass] [traitor_leader.GetName]§!, which presents a considerable security risk. We must deal with this conspirator while maintaining some sense of stability. Public knowledge of this level of corruption would have serious repercussions for our government.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2600`

## grand_archive.8545.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8545.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

不幸的是，我们无法阻止§Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§!的破坏行动。他们的破坏者已经彻底破坏了我们的后勤基础设施，重建供应链将需要数年时间。他们在我们的恒星系中传播的腐败规模太大，无法得到缓解。\n\n然而，这不会阻止我们以我们的名义夺取§Y$NESS_GRAND_ARCHIVE$§!。我们只需要在战斗中击败海盗，宝藏就会属于我们。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2226`

### English

Unfortunately, we were unable to thwart the devastating operations of §Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§!. Their saboteurs have damaged our logistics infrastructure beyond repair, and it will take many years to rebuild our supply chains. The corruption they've spread throughout our systems is on too grand of a scale to be mitigated.\n\nHowever, this will not stop us from claiming §Y$NESS_GRAND_ARCHIVE$§! in our name. All that we must do is defeat the pirates in battle, and the treasure will be ours.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2632`

### 中文

尽管§Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§!竭尽全力破坏我们的基础设施，我们依然得到恢复并稳定了局势。他们的特工已被击败，剩下的就是与他们在[hoard_system.GetName]集结的舰队对抗，并以[root.GetName]的名义夺取§Y$NESS_GRAND_ARCHIVE$§!。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2229`

### English

Despite the extensive efforts of the §Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§! to sabotage our infrastructure, we have recovered and stabilized. With their agents defeated, all that remains is to confront their amassed fleet in [hoard_system.GetName] and claim §Y$NESS_GRAND_ARCHIVE$§! in the name of [root.GetName].

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2635`

## TREASURE_HUNTERS_BLACK_NEEDLE_PROJECT_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ATREASURE_HUNTERS_BLACK_NEEDLE_PROJECT_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

在对[root.GetName]的恒星系进行大规模破坏性攻击后，$NAME_BlackNeedle$仍然维持着对§H$NESS_GRAND_ARCHIVE$§!的封锁。他们已经耗尽了大部分资源，现在处于脆弱状态。如果我们在这里击败他们，他们的整个组织必然会崩溃，让我们可以自由地夺取宝藏。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2236`

### English

Following extensive sabotage attacks on [root.GetName] systems, the $NAME_BlackNeedle$ have maintained their blockade around §H$NESS_GRAND_ARCHIVE$§!. They have exhausted much of their resources, and are now in a vulnerable position. If we defeat them here, their wider organization will surely crumble, allowing us to freely claim the treasure.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2643`

## grand_archive.8560.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8560.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

奈斯的孩子们……真是讽刺。\n\n是她选择了你——你知道吗？\n\n数百种物种任她挑选……她却选择了你。也许她看到了你身上的特别之处，也许这只是一场纯粹的偶然。无论如何，我们都走到了这一步。\n\n你赢了……暂时。不要轻视这场胜利。你已经树立了强大的敌人——我们，§Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§!我们不会宽恕，也不会忘记。\n\n就像我的祖先一样，我们会坚持下去。我们会一点一点地重建我们失去的一切。即使需要一千年，一百万年——我们也会回来，夺回你从我们手中夺走的一切。\n\n$NAME_BlackNeedle$将永远存在！永远！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2239`

### English

Ness's children... how ironic.\n\nShe chose you - do you know that?\n\nHundreds of species to choose from... and she chose you. Maybe she saw something special in you, or maybe it was complete chance. Either way, here we are.\n\nYou win... for now. Do not dare take this victory lightly. You have made a powerful enemy in us. The §Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§! does not forgive, and we do not forget.\n\nAs my ancestors did before me, we will persevere. We will rebuild what we have lost piece by piece. Even if it takes a thousand years, a million years - we will return and reclaim everything you have stolen from us.\n\nThe $NAME_BlackNeedle$ will live on forever! Forever!

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2647`

## CAPTAIN_NESS_HOARD_PROJECT_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ACAPTAIN_NESS_HOARD_PROJECT_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

§H$NESS_GRAND_ARCHIVE$§!近在咫尺了。\n\n尽管它看起来被遗弃了，但建筑物的许多系统仍在运行。考虑到§H$NAME_CaptainNess$§!的传说性质，我们应该警惕预料之外的安全措施。\n\n这个宝库的唯一入口在其中央舱口处有一个凹槽。我们可以将§H$celestial_chart$§!插入这里，打开这个神秘的设施。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2243`

### English

§H$NESS_GRAND_ARCHIVE$§! is ours to take.\n\nDespite its abandoned appearance, many of the building's systems are active. Given the alleged nature of §H$NAME_CaptainNess$§!, we should be cautious of unexpected security measures.\n\nThe singular entrance of the treasure trove has an indent carved into its central hatch. We can insert the §H$celestial_chart$§! here to open this mysterious facility.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2652`

## grand_archive.8565.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8565.name&lang=en)

### 中文

$NAME_CaptainNess$宝藏

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2244`

### English

$NAME_CaptainNess$'s Treasure

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2654`

## grand_archive.8565.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8565.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§Y$celestial_chart$§!是钥匙，而宝库是它的锁。我们把它插入巨型结构的主舱口。\n\n星图启动，内部追踪着一道单一的的光束，指向我们旅程中经过的每一颗恒星。古老的机器发出咯吱咯吱的响声，我们很快便进入了内部。\n\n来自一千个世界的难以置信的宝藏，在地板和墙壁上堆积如山。精致的雕像与用贵金属打造的攻击武器并列。精美的珠宝悬挂在古老化石的末端，复杂的装置堆积成一堆，毫无秩序。\n\n金属的脚步声从中央走道传来。一只充满液体的类人生物机器，举起双臂投降，向我们走来。它的语音电路发出噼啪声，启动了：\n\n§L“所以……你最终还是找到了我的星图。你真聪明。”§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2245`

### English

The §Y$celestial_chart$§! was a key, and the vault was its lock. We inserted it into the main hatch of the megastructure.\n\nThe chart activated, internally tracing a singular beam of light to each star along our journey. Ancient machinery groaned to life, and we were soon inside.\n\nIncredible treasures looted from a thousand worlds line the floor and walls in abundance. Delicate statues are juxtaposed against assault weapons forged in precious metals. Fine jewelry hangs from the extremities of antique fossils and complex devices are piled up in an orderless heap.\n\nMetallic footsteps ring out from the central walkway. Arms raised in surrender, a fluid-filled humanoid machine approaches us. Its voice circuits crackle into activation:\n\n§L"So... you found my chart after all. Aren't you clever?"§!

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2655`

## grand_archive.8565.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8565.a&lang=en)

### 中文

开启通讯。

## grand_archive.8570.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8570.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H尽管她的机械形态限制了其表达能力，但被称为奈斯船长的机器却用一种自鸣得意的眼神看着我们。她的金属身体没有丝毫磨损的迹象，仿佛刚组装不久。她的语气既耐心又居高临下，仿佛在对一个地位低于她的人说话。§!\n\n我想应该做个自我介绍，尽管你可能已经猜到我是谁了。\n\n我叫桑达·奈斯，或者至少以前是。曾经的“星海海盗女王”，现在是这堆冰冷螺栓的主人。\n\n§H机器停顿了一下，观察着我们的形态。§!\n\n我已经很久没有见过你们这种生物了。看起来你们这些原始人已经长大成人了！\n\n我必须说，我对你们能来到这里感到非常惊讶。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2248`

### English

§HDespite the limited expressions available in her robotic form, the machine known as Captain Ness regards us with a certain smugness. Her metallic body shows no sign of wear and tear, as if only recently assembled. Her tone is patient yet patronizing, as if addressing one below her status.§!\n\nI suppose some introduction is in order, though you may already have guessed who I am.\n\nThe name's Saanda Ness, or at least it was. Former "Pirate Queen of the Galaxy" and current occupant of this cold pile of bolts.\n\n§HThe machine pauses for a moment, taking in our forms.§!\n\nIt's been a long time since I last saw your species. Looks like you primitives are all grown up!\n\nI must say, I'm quite impressed you've made it here.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2659`

## grand_archive.8570.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8570.a&lang=en)

### 中文

你是怎么活下来的？

### English

How are you alive?

## grand_archive.8570.a.reply_fallen_empire

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8570.a.reply_fallen_empire&lang=en)

### 中文

永生可不是便宜货。我花了几百万能量币，请了[fallen_empire.GetRealName]的科学家帮我转移意识，而且没引起警觉。他们干得还不错，但我现在跳起舞来可没以前那么好了。\n\n$grand_archive.8570.a.reply$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2250`

### English

Immortality doesn't come cheap. I paid some scientists from [fallen_empire.GetRealName] a few million credits to transfer my consciousness without raising the alarm. They did a fair job, but I can't dance as well as I used to.\n\n$grand_archive.8570.a.reply$

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2661`

## grand_archive.8570.a.reply_curator

### 中文

永生可不是便宜货。我花了几百万能量币，请了$NAME_Curator_Order$的科学家帮我转移意识，而且没引起警觉。他们干得还不错，但我现在跳起舞来可没以前那么好了。\n\n$grand_archive.8570.a.reply$

### English

Immortality doesn't come cheap. I paid some scientists from $NAME_Curator_Order$ a few million credits to transfer my consciousness without raising the alarm. They did a fair job, but I can't dance as well as I used to.\n\n$grand_archive.8570.a.reply$

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2662`

## grand_archive.8570.a.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8570.a.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

§H机器启动了一个控制台，露出墙上隐藏的一个密室。一个古老的冷冻舱里，躺着一位有机生物的遗骸。§!\n\n我在这里。一个无用的装饰品，但我有点怀旧。我看起来不错，对吧？\n\n我确认一切就绪后，锁上了这个保险库，然后休眠了几千年。下一件事，你就打开了门，我们现在正在进行这场对话。感觉就像昨天我躺下睡觉一样……

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2252`

### English

§HThe machine activates a console, revealing a chamber hidden in the wall. Within an ancient cryo-pod are the remains of an organic being.§!\n\nHere I am. A useless ornament, but I'm a bit sentimental. Looked good, didn't I?\n\nOnce I checked that everything was in place, I locked up this vault and powered down for a few thousand years. Next thing I know, you've opened the door and we're having this conversation. Feels like only yesterday I laid down to sleep...

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2663`

## grand_archive.8570.b

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8570.b&lang=en)

### 中文

你这些宝藏是从哪里来的？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2253`

### English

Where did you get all of this treasure?

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2664`

## grand_archive.8570.b.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8570.b.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

大部分都是偷来的，或者用其他不义之财换来的。我曾经从星海的所有大人物那里偷过东西。货船、巨像武器，你随便说，我都劫持过。我的逻辑是，如果我能这么容易地从你那里拿走东西，说明你根本不在乎，不配拥有它。\n\n有时候事情会变得……很糟糕。你看到了乙特人发生了什么。那件事让我大开眼界。\n\n玩玩闹闹，直到不再有趣……

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2254`

### English

Stole it, mostly. Or traded it for other ill-gotten goods. I ripped off every major player in the galaxy once upon a time. Cargo ships, Colossus weapons; you name it, I've hijacked it. My logic was that if I could take something so easily from you, you didn't care enough to deserve it.\n\nThings would sometimes get... messy. You saw what happened to the Ytterites. That one was an eye-opener.\n\nIt's all fun and games until it's not any more...

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2665`

## grand_archive.8570.c

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8570.c&lang=en)

### 中文

为什么选我们？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2255`

### English

Why choose us?

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2666`

## grand_archive.8570.c.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8570.c.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

如果说是因为我孤独，你会相信吗？\n\n§H机器的语音电路发出应该称之为笑声的咯咯声。§!\n\n我拥有了所有这些财富，但为了什么？最终能给我带来什么？我意识到我想要的不是财富，而是传承。但是，你无法偷走传承——那么如何创造一个呢？\n\n好吧，我是这么打算的。我找到了几个最有希望的原始物种，并在他们的世界中播下了宝藏——当然还有地图。第一个拼凑出我的藏宝图的人将通过考验，并有资格继承我毕生的基业。于是……我们就在这里碰面了。\n\n也许你们一族能做到我做不到的事情，并将所有这些付诸实践。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2256`

### English

Would you believe me if I said I was lonely?\n\n§HThe machine's vocal circuits crackled with what might have been laughter.§!\n\nI had all of this treasure, but for what? What does it get me in the end? I realized it wasn't riches that I wanted; it was a legacy. But, you can't steal a legacy - so how do you create one?\n\nWell, this was my shot at it. I found a few of the most promising primitive species and seeded their worlds with treasure - and the map of course. Whoever pieced together my chart first would pass the test and be worthy of inheriting my life's work. So... here we are.\n\nMaybe your kind can do what I could not, and put all of this to good use.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2667`

## grand_archive.8570.d

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8570.d&lang=en)

### 中文

为什么抛弃一切？

Why give away everything?

## grand_archive.8570.d.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8570.d.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

我已经告诉过你们，我要把火炬传下去。我并不擅长花钱，只会赚钱。\n\n不过，我不能把钱随便给任何人。他们必须足够聪明才能来到这里；一支我能为之骄傲的队伍。一支我能与之分享我的故事的队伍……

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2258`

### English

I've told you, I'm passing on the torch. I'm not good at spending money, only taking it.\n\nI couldn't give it away to just anyone, though. They had to be clever enough to reach this place; a crew I could be proud of. One I could share my story with...

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2669`

## grand_archive.8570.e

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8570.e&lang=en)

你的什么故事？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2259`

### English

What's your story?

## grand_archive.8570.e.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8570.e.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

好吧，既然你诚心诚意地发问了……\n\n§H机器启动了一个控制台，一系列数字记录被投射到墙上。§!\n\n整个藏宝库都是我的自传。我花了很多钱雇佣了一支作家团队，记录下我生命中所有可以记住的时刻。我认为他们做得还不错。\n\n§H图像切换到一个海盗船员的驾驶舱画面，船长奈斯的生物形态在指挥。机器的语音电路发出一声短暂的噼啪声；那是一声叹息。§!\n\n我曾经是星系中最令人恐惧的海盗。我让大型企业破产，勒索星球，并将整个帝国夷为平地。任何愚蠢到敢于反对我的人，要么被我的[root.GetSpeciesOrganName]刺穿，要么被卖掉换取赏金。我自己的赏金？天文数字。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2260`

### English

Well, since you asked...\n\n§HThe machine activates a console, and a series of digital recordings are projected across the wall.§!\n\nThis entire vault is my biography. I paid a great deal to a team of authors to record every moment of my life that could be remembered. They did a fair job of it, I think.\n\n§HThe images shift to a cockpit image of a pirate crew, the biological form of Captain Ness in command. A short crackle escapes the machine's voice circuits; it has the weight of a sigh.§!\n\nI was once the most feared pirate in the galaxy. I've bankrupted mega-corporations, ransomed planets, and reduced entire empires to rubble. Anyone foolish enough to oppose me got a blade in their [root.GetSpeciesOrganName] or were sold off for a bounty. My own bounty? Astronomical.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2671`

## grand_archive.8570.f

请继续。

## grand_archive.8570.f.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8570.f.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

§H各种抢劫、盗窃和惊险逃脱的数字记录，伴随着史诗音乐的投影，在屏幕上播放。§!\n\n起初，我精心挑选目标，并为自己的行为寻找正当理由，认为他们罪有应得。每一次行动都比上一次更刺激。这是一个循环：计划、妖魔化、抢劫、然后庆祝。问题是寻找“坏”目标太耗时了。我需要拓宽视野。\n\n最终，如果我想要什么，我就直接拿走。我喜欢看着数字上涨，我的战利品的价值和我的宝藏的价值。我在世界上留下了自己的印记，我将永远不会被遗忘。其他一切都不重要。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2262`

### English

§HDigital recordings of various hold-ups, heists, and daring escapes, all set to heroic music are projected.§!\n\nAt first, I picked my targets carefully and found some justification as to why they deserved it. Each job was more exciting than the last. It was a cycle: planning, demonizing, robbing, then celebrating. The problem was that looking for "bad" targets was too time-consuming. I needed to expand my horizons.\n\nEventually, if there was something I wanted, I'd just take it. I enjoyed watching the numbers go up; the price of my bounty and the value of my hoard. I was leaving my mark on the world and I'd never be forgotten. Everything else was unimportant.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2673`

什么改变了？

### English

What changed?

## grand_archive.8570.g.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8570.g.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

§H乙特人的家园已经成为一片废墟。§!\n\n然后，乙特星事件发生了……你看到了吧？我还记得广播里传来的哭喊声，那是他们最后生命的消逝。事情已经走得太远了。是时候改变了。\n\n在我的职业生涯中，我发现了一个规律：历史会淡忘，教训会被遗忘，总会有新人来接替你的位置。我只是想选择接替我的人。\n\n那就是你。你们[root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]通过了考验。接下来会发生什么，就取决于你了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2264`

### English

§HThe Ytterite homeworld is displayed in ruin.§!\n\nThen the Yterrite incident happened... You saw it, right? I still remember the cries on the radio as the last of their lives were snuffed out. Things went too far. It was time for a change.\n\nThere was a pattern I discovered over my career: History fades, lessons are forgotten, and someone new takes your place. I simply wanted to be able to pick who came after me.\n\nThat's you. You [root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] passed the test. What happens next is up to you.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2675`

## grand_archive.8575.desc.default

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8575.desc.default&lang=en)

### 中文

§Y$NESS_GRAND_ARCHIVE$§!包含着难以置信的财富。然而，我们必须考虑以我们的名义宣称它所带来的后果。\n\n她宝藏中的每一笔信用都是非法获得的。获取这些资源将意味着我们容忍$NAME_CaptainNess$的过度犯罪行为，以换取物质财富。\n\n话虽如此，许多被$NAME_CaptainNess$伤害的人早已不在人世。宣称这笔财富不会造成新的受害者。此外，我们已经消灭了§Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§!，从而使星系变得更加安全。经过漫长的危险旅程，我们理所当然地应该得到丰厚的回报。\n\n我们必须决定如何处理它。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2266`

### English

§Y$NESS_GRAND_ARCHIVE$§! contains an incredible bounty of wealth. We must however consider the consequences of claiming it in our name.\n\nEvery credit of her treasure was earned illegally. Taking these resources would represent a tolerance of $NAME_CaptainNess$'s excessive criminality in exchange for material wealth.\n\nThat said, many of those wronged by $NAME_CaptainNess$ are long gone. Claiming this wealth would create no new victims. Furthermore, we have decimated the §Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§! and thus made the galaxy a safer place. Having traveled this long path fraught with danger, we arguably deserve a sizable reward for our efforts.\n\nWe must make a decision on what to do with its contents.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2678`

## grand_archive.8575.desc.lom

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8575.desc.lom&lang=en)

### 中文

§Y$NESS_GRAND_ARCHIVE$§!是终极的藏宝地，我们很高兴能获得它的战利品。\n\n这是打败了§Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§!的应得奖励——为[this.GetName]三呼万岁！\n\n让我们清理这个金库。所有[This.Species.GetHandNamePlural]准备就位！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2267`

### English

§Y$NESS_GRAND_ARCHIVE$§! is the ultimate treasure trove, and we are pleased to claim its booty.\n\nA hard-earned reward for taking down the §Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§! - three cheers for [this.GetName]!\n\nLet's clear out this vault. All [This.Species.GetHandNamePlural] on deck!

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2679`

## grand_archive.8580.desc.1

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8580.desc.1&lang=en)

### 中文

§H现在被称为§Y$NAME_CaptainNess$§!的机器对我们清空她的珍宝库的速度印象深刻。§!\n\n去吧，你应得的。这笔财富里包含着许多血汗和泪水。别在一个地方花光了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2273`

### English

§HThe machine now known as §Y$NAME_CaptainNess$§! was impressed at how quickly we emptied her vault.§!\n\nGo ahead, you deserve it. There's a lot of blood, sweat, and tears in this treasure. Don't spend it all in one place.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2686`

## grand_archive.8580.desc.2

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8580.desc.2&lang=en)

### 中文

§H现在被称为§Y$NAME_CaptainNess$§!的机器对我们想要归还她辛苦赚来的宝藏感到不安。§!\n\n真是令人失望。所以某个第十五代继承人会得到他们祖先的旧首饰。好吧，希望你们能把剩下的东西用在更有价值的项目上。尽管你们最近干了些蠢事，但我相信你们会把这件事做好。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2274`

### English

§HThe machine now known as §Y$NAME_CaptainNess$§! was perturbed at our desire to repatriate some of her hard-earned treasure.§!\n\nHow disappointing. So some fifteenth-generation heirling will get their ancestor's old jewelry. Well, hopefully you'll use whatever's left on a worthier project. Despite recent evidence, I trust you to get this right.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2687`

## grand_archive.8580.desc.3

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8580.desc.3&lang=en)

### 中文

§H现在被称为§Y$NAME_CaptainNess$§!的机器得知我们要把她的全部积蓄都送出去，感到十分厌恶。§!\n\n这就是你的计划？免费送给所有人？他们做了什么值得得到这些？真是浪费！\n\n我对你原本抱有更高的期望……至少让我指挥一些你的舰队，让我可以再试一次曾经的海盗生涯。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2275`

### English

§HThe machine now known as §Y$NAME_CaptainNess$§! was disgusted when she learned that we would be giving away her entire hoard.§!\n\nThis is your master plan? Free stuff for everyone? What did they do to deserve any of it? What a waste!\n\nI thought better of you... at least give me command of some of your fleets so I can try this all over again.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2688`

## grand_archive.8580.desc.default

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8580.desc.default&lang=en)

### 中文

§H现在的问题是该如何处理$NAME_CaptainNess$本人。作为一名经验丰富的舰船驾驶员，她经历过无数危险遭遇，将成为我们军队中优秀的指挥官。或者，她也可以在我们队伍中担任更具保障性的角色，培训下一代飞行员。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2276`

### English

§HThe question remains of what to do with $NAME_CaptainNess$ herself. As an experienced pilot who has survived a multitude of dangerous encounters, she would be an excellent asset to our military as a Commander. Alternatively, she could take a more supporting role within our ranks to train our next generation of pilots.§!

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2689`

## grand_archive.8580.desc.no_lom

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8580.desc.no_lom&lang=en)

### 中文

§H或者我们也可以她关起来，以此向我们的公民表明，任何罪行都不会逍遥法外。她将有足够的时间反思自己的所作所为。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2277`

### English

§HThat is unless we simply incarcerate her to set an example to our citizens that no crime goes unpunished. She would have a long time to think about what she's done.§!

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2690`

## grand_archive.8580.desc.gestalt

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8580.desc.gestalt&lang=en)

### 中文

§H唯一剩下的决定是关于$NAME_CaptainNess$本人。作为一名强大的独立思想者，她可以成为一名独特的指挥官，提供出敌不意的创意策略。或者，我们可以将她的丰富战斗经验融入我们的集体知识中，并利用它来进一步加深我们对战争的理解。\n\n或者我们也可以干脆将她囚禁起来，以表明在[this.GetName]中不容忍背叛和犯罪行为。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2278`

### English

§HThe only remaining decision is to do with $NAME_CaptainNess$ herself. As a powerful independent mind, she would make for a unique asset in a Commander role, offering creative strategies that could catch opponents off-guard. Alternatively, we could integrate her vast combat experience into our collective knowledge and use it to further our wider understanding of warfare.\n\nThat is unless we simply imprison her to make it clear that deviance and criminality are not to be tolerated within [this.GetName].§!

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2691`

## grand_archive.8590.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8590.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

你这个脑袋空空的傻屌！我给你整个世界，你却只给我一副新的镣铐？你不配得到我给你的东西！你甚至不配为我擦靴子！\n\n愿这[this.GetName]上留下一块黑斑，诅咒你们所有人！\n\n愿你们的[this.species.GetRemnantNamePlural]在虚空中枯萎，愿你们的名字被人遗忘。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2286`

### English

You empty-minded echo! I offer you the world and all I get is a fresh pair of cuffs? You don't deserve what I've given you! You don't deserve to clean my boots!\n\nA black spot on the [this.GetName], a curse upon you all!\n\nMay your [this.species.GetRemnantNamePlural] wither in the void and and your name be forgotten.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2701`

### English

$NAME_CaptainNess$ Deactivated

## grand_archive.8595.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8595.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

名为§Y$NAME_CaptainNess$§!的机器俘虏被发现在她的牢房里停机。我们相信她故意导致了电路的严重故障，关闭了关键系统，并从她转移的意识中删除了所有存储的数据。在她牢房的墙壁上发现了一条潦草的留言：\n\n§L与你同归于尽……§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2289`

### English

The captive machine known as §Y$NAME_CaptainNess$§! was found deactivated in her cell. We believe that she had purposely caused a critical malfunction in her circuits, shutting down crucial systems and erasing all stored data from her transferred consciousness. A message was found scribbled on her cell walls:\n\n§LTo the void with you...§!

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2705`

## grand_archive.8600.desc.common

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8600.desc.common&lang=en)

### 中文

现在是时候开创自己的命运了。没有星图可循，星辰将成为我们的指引。\n\n我们将取得什么成就？我们将如何被铭记？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2292`

### English

Now it is time to forge our own destiny. With no chart left to follow, the stars themselves will be our guide.\n\nWhat will we achieve? How will we be remembered?

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2709`

## grand_archive.8600.desc.default

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.8600.desc.default&lang=en)

### 中文

这场冒险已经结束。寻找§H船长奈斯§!的宝藏的任务已经完成。\n\n$grand_archive.8600.desc.common$\n\n这才是[this.GetName]故事的真正开始。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2293`

### English

This adventure has come to an end. The quest for the Treasure of §HCaptain Ness§! is complete.\n\n$grand_archive.8600.desc.common$\n\nThis is where the story of [this.GetName] truly begins.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2710`

## grand_archive.8600.desc.lom

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.9970.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在[from.solar_system.GetName]成功克隆出首例太空兽群。\n\n我们对异星生物学的深入研究表明，我们可以进一步增强这些生物的生理机能，如果我们选择这样做的话。这将使我们能够为生物舰队配备专门的战斗组件。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2302`

### English

This will allow us to outfit our biological fleets with specialized combat components.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2721`

Examples of these components include, but are not limited to:\n- §H$SPACE_WHALE_WEAPON_1$§!\n- §H$AMOEBA_STRIKE_CRAFT$§!

## FEDERATION_CREATURE_FLEET_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AFEDERATION_CREATURE_FLEET_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

§H联邦舰队§!是联邦主席国控制的特殊舰队。它们在§H联邦$CREATURE_DESIGNER$§!中进行设计，在设计之中可以使用联邦各国最顶尖的科技。联邦舰队不需维护费用，但总量不能超过§H联邦海军容量§!，每个成员至少贡献其自身§Y$PERC|0%$§!的§H海军容量§!。如果太空兽群舰队规模超过§H联邦海军容量§!，额外的生物将被分配给联邦主席国。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2376`

### English

§HFederation Fleets§! are special fleets that are controlled by the Federation President. They are designed in the §HFederation $CREATURE_DESIGNER$§! and can use any technology available to any member of the Federation. Federation Fleets cost no upkeep, but cannot exceed the §HFederation Naval Capacity§!, to which each member contributes at least §Y$PERC|0%$§! of their own §HNaval Capacity§!. If Space Fauna fleets grow to exceed §HFederation Naval Capacity§!, extra creatures will be given to the Federation President.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2808`

## space_amoeba_UNIQUE_MUTATION_PROJECT_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aspace_amoeba_UNIQUE_MUTATION_PROJECT_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

在我们对新克隆生物进行训练的过程中，一只受伤的太空变形虫使用了一种新技术击败了对手。变形虫的鞭毛能够从训练伙伴的天然防御中吸取营养和物质，用它们来修补自身盔甲上的漏洞，并恢复战斗力。\n\n对这种现象的进一步研究可能会揭示太空变形虫生物学的一个新元素，可以对其进行增强，从而开发出一种新的物种特异性突变。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2411`

### English

During our training process of newly cloned organisms, an injured Space Amoeba used a novel technique to defeat its opponent. The Amoeba's flagella were able to siphon nutrients and materials from its training partner's natural defenses, using them to patch holes in their own armor and regain fighting strength.\n\nAdditional research into this phenomenon may reveal a new element of Space Amoeba biology that can be enhanced to develop a new species-specific mutation.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2850`

## tiyanki_UNIQUE_MUTATION_PROJECT_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Atiyanki_UNIQUE_MUTATION_PROJECT_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

最近克隆的一支缇扬奇舰队被观察到正在进行交流，反复发出复杂的叫声。这些几乎无法察觉的声音似乎给附近的所有其他生物带来了安慰和平静。\n\n对这种现象的进一步研究可能会揭示缇扬奇生物学的一个新元素，可以增强该元素以开发出特定物种的突变。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2413`

### English

A recently cloned fleet of Tiyanki were observed communing together, repeatedly emitting a series of complex vocalizations. The barely detectable sounds seemed to bring comfort and calm to every other creature nearby.\n\nAdditional research into this phenomenon may reveal a new element of Tiyanki biology that can be enhanced to develop a species-specific mutation.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2852`

## voidworm_UNIQUE_MUTATION_PROJECT_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Avoidworm_UNIQUE_MUTATION_PROJECT_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

我们注意到一些虚空虫在成熟时会形成小的囊肿状生长物。进一步观察表明，带有这些难看水泡的样本通常比它们的同类更具繁殖力。\n\n对这种现象的进一步研究可能会揭示虚空虫生物学的一个新元素，可以增强该元素以开发出特定物种的突变。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2415`

### English

We have noticed that some of our Voidworms tend to develop small cyst-like growths as they reach maturity. Further observation showed that specimens with these unsightly blisters are typically more fertile than their counterparts.\n\nAdditional research into this phenomenon may reveal a new element of Voidworm biology that can be enhanced to develop a species-specific mutation.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2854`

## cutholoid_UNIQUE_MUTATION_PROJECT_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acutholoid_UNIQUE_MUTATION_PROJECT_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

由于过度投喂，我们记录到了一只克隆岩居兽发生了剧烈的呕吐。从其胃部喷出的消化液作为浓缩抛射体非常致命，即使在离开该生物的躯体很长时间后还保有放射性。\n\n对这一现象的进一步研究揭示了岩居兽的生理学中有一种新的元素可以用来增强物种特有变异过程。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2417`

### English

As a result of overfeeding, one of our cloned Cutholoids was recorded violently ejecting the contents of its stomach. The resulting digestive fluids proved to be quite deadly as a concentrated projectile, maintaining their radioactive qualities for significant time outside of the creature's body.\n\nAdditional research into this phenomenon may reveal a new element of Cutholoid biology that can be enhanced to develop a species-specific mutation.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2856`

## grand_archive.10010.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.10010.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们关于§Y空间变形虫§!的变异实验完成了，得到了一些有趣的新细胞器：可部署的§Y$tech_unique_mutation_space_amoeba$§!。\n\n这些共生生物能够从附近物体中汲取能量并将其返还给宿主，从而增强生存能力和再生能力。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2436`

### English

Our experimental mutation project on §YSpace Amoebas§! is complete, and has yielded some interesting new organelles: deployable §Y$tech_unique_mutation_space_amoeba$§!.\n\nThese symbiotic organisms are able to drain energy from nearby objects and return it to its host, enhancing survivability and regeneration.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2877`

## grand_archive.10015.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.10015.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们对§Y缇扬奇§!的变异实验完成了，得到了一个有趣的结果：§Y$tech_unique_mutation_tiyanki$§!\n\n我们已经将这些生物在它们群体中用于交流的自然振动放大到可持续的最大水平。这将产生一个可控的场，增强附近其他生物的组织。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2438`

### English

Our experimental mutation project on §YTiyankis§! is complete, and has yielded some interesting enhancements: §Y$tech_unique_mutation_tiyanki$§!\n\nWe have amplified the natural vibrations these creatures use for communication within their herds to the maximum sustainable level. This results in a controllable field that strengthens the tissue of other nearby creatures.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2879`

## grand_archive.10020.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.10020.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们对§Y虚空虫§!的变异实验完成了，得到了一些有趣的繁殖周期变异：§Y$tech_unique_mutation_voidworm$§!\n\n我们已经能够提高这些生物用来轰炸宿主星球的寄生囊肿的繁殖能力。结果是产生的若虫产量增加。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2440`

### English

Our experimental mutation project on §YVoidworms§! is complete, and has yielded some interesting variations of their reproductive cycles: §Y$tech_unique_mutation_voidworm$§!\n\nWe have been able to increase the fertility of the parasitic cysts these creatures use to bombard their host planets with. The result is an increase in yield of generated nymphs.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2881`

## grand_archive.10025.desc

### 中文

我们对§Y岩居兽§!的变异实验完成了，得到了一个有趣的结果：§Y$tech_unique_mutation_cutholoid$§!\n\n我们已经找到方法能将其巨大消化系统改造为发射高初速长射程弹药的武器。不幸的是，这一显著的生物学改造会导致它们无法再吞噬敌方舰船了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2442`

### English

Our experimental mutation project on §YCutholoids§! is complete, and has yielded some interesting results: §Y$tech_unique_mutation_cutholoid$§!\n\nWe have found a way to repurpose their massive digestive system to fire high velocity, long-range projectiles. Unfortunately, this significant biological modification will mean they are no longer able to engulf enemy fleets.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2883`

### 中文

我们关于§Y晶态实体§!的变异实验完成了，得到了一些有趣的结果：§Y$tech_unique_mutation_crystalline_entity$§!\n\n通过对它们晶体基因的这种修改，每个生物在遭受严重创伤时能够分裂成两个独立的个体。这将极大地提高它们的战斗能力。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2444`

### English

Our experimental mutation project on §YCrystalline Entities§! is complete, and has yielded some interesting results: §Y$tech_unique_mutation_crystalline_entity$§!\n\nWith this modification to their crystalline genetics, each creature is capable of splitting into two independent organisms in the event of severe trauma. This should drastically improve their combat capabilities.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2885`

## grand_archive.10030.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.10030.a&lang=en)

### 中文

## grand_archive.10060.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.10060.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们使用$NAME_Elderly_Tiyanki$的遗传物质进行的变异实验完成了，得到了一些有趣的结果：§H$restorative_enzymes$§!\n\n族母遗传物质中存在的修复酶可以在其他生物的类似腺体中复制。这将它们的结构组织转化为再生材料，在爆炸时紧密编队中会非常有用。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2451`

### English

Our experimental mutation project using $NAME_Elderly_Tiyanki$ genetic material is complete, and has yielded some interesting results: §H$restorative_enzymes$§!\n\nThe restorative enzymes present in the Matriarch's genetic material can be reproduced in similar glands on other creatures. This transforms their structural tissue into regenerative material, which would provide quite useful in tight formations upon explosion.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2893`

## grand_archive.10080.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agrand_archive.10080.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们使用$NAME_Voidspawn$基因材料进行的变异实验完成了，得到了一个有趣的发现：§H$starborne_biology$§!\n\n这些生物的组织对星光反应强烈，可以被鼓励在其他生物体中生长。这需要少量能量来维持，但在最亮的恒星附近，它们的生长速度会大幅提高。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2455`

### English

Our experimental mutation project using $NAME_Voidspawn$ genetic material is complete, and has yielded an interesting discovery: §H$starborne_biology$§!\n\nThe tissue of these creatures reacts strongly to starlight, and can be encouraged to grow in other organisms. This demands a small amount of energy to maintain, but vastly improves their growth rate near the brightest stars.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:2897`

## space_amoeba_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aspace_amoeba_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

太空变形虫是孤独的掠食者，对遇到的任何东西都具有攻击性。它们依靠被称为“鞭毛”的半成形后代，擅长追捕猎物。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2568`

### English

Space Amoeba are lone predators, aggressive towards anything they encounter. Supported by partially-formed spawn known as "flagella", these creatures are adept at chasing down their prey.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:3026`

## tiyanki_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Atiyanki_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

缇扬奇，也被称为“太空鲸”，通常是温顺的生物，以大气气体为食。这些生物极具协作性，野生群体在严格的等级制度下组织。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2569`

### English

Tiyanki, also known as "Space Whales", are typically docile creatures that graze on atmospheric gases. These creatures are extremely collaborative and pods in the wild are organized under a strict hierarchy.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:3027`

## voidworm_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Avoidworm_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

虚空虫是一种寄生生物，为了繁殖，必须将其孢子降落到有适量生物质的居住世界。成熟的个体会形成被称为“三头虫”的形态，并在黑洞附近建造巢穴来庇护和抚养幼虫。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2570`

### English

Voidworms are parasitic organisms that must deposit spores on inhabited worlds with suitable biomass in order to reproduce. Mature individuals form mating trios, known as "Troikas", and will construct nests near black holes to shelter and raise their young.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:3028`

## cutholoid_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acutholoid_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

岩居兽是一种居住在小行星内巨型有机体，它们利用外壳来保护柔软的身体。该生物会将猎物整个生吞，用放射性的消化液来慢慢消化。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2571`

### English

Cutholoids are massive organisms that inhabit asteroids in order to provide suitable protection for their otherwise soft bodies. This creature swallows its prey whole, using radioactive digestive fluid to slowly consume its prey.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:3029`

## crystalline_entity_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrystalline_entity_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

晶态实体是一种独特的硅酸盐生命体，能够在太空中自由移动。每个实体的颜色并非由年龄决定，而是反映了它们潜在的内部电荷。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/grand_archive_l_simp_chinese.yml:2572`

### English

Crystalline Entities are a unique form of silicate-animate beings that can freely propel themselves through space. The hue of each entity varies not due to age, but as a reflection of their latent internal charge.

Source: `localisation/english/grand_archive_l_english.yml:3030`
